entries.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 BC1 在同等基本救助的既定范围内支持保全更多生活；BC2 的一对一说明以可避免的实际毁损给出比较理由，区分境况、保护与时机，并保留机会争议。 形成中的评估区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法。恢复过去的历史与取得新根据是两件事，所以历史区别无法恢复，不阻止以未来事件取得同一内容的新根据或修订理解；情境把握与风险估计可支持继续生成。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。 关切发展接续具体化真实根据保留、改变及新形成时的双向纠正，并将学习中取得的解释纳入形成账户；五条候选路线保留各自正面作用。 后续路线评估以已有局部关切取得新关系内容并重组目的为理论主线，配套形成史判别，再选择机制研究；认识进步与实际新理由不以价值权重增加为定义。 LC 接通数量与程度共同改善的有限损失比较理由：实际损失的有根据匹配及额外保护可以共同支持方向；重复描述不增加生活，共同依存须进入损失判断。 情境风险接续区分个别改善与共同失效；精确有限界限允许部分把握和正风险，支持关系修订可解除共同中断，同时保留分散损失。 有限合并接续区分抵偿限制与理由删除：最强层过滤可在增加实际基本保护后翻转选择；固定比较与局部胜出拼接的条件分别公开。 关切内容形成现有一条具体候选：已有局部关切使粗略成功与实际回应的分离取得实践意义，关系辨别通过计划修订改变目的；实际新生活及对它的动机取得分列。 LR 为同等多救的充分优先提出局部稳定承诺，使一部分稍不等的基本损失有正面比较；新增共同保护另可逐次保留旧保护，增加原先冲突的实现。 同等基本风险分担RS现有正面理由：完整损失分布相当时，减轻无根据的暴露集中；同频率选择可产生不同真实风险，新信息也能支持进一步改规则。 现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。 机会修订接续表明：最终保护的完整联合分布相同仍可能撤销正当安顿；选择规则须保留仍有效的历史要求，并说明真实纠正的根据。 陌生与无回报的关切扩展现有两段条件性说明：辨明对方在自身参与之外的生活，再取得陌生处境中的相关根据；共同史是形成入口，不是全部关切的边界。 CP为不等且未被充分排除的基本请求提出真实正机会要求，将共同分配权限与基本回应关系相连；它是新增且可争辩的进入承诺。 陌生生活辨认现接通具体实现、支撑关系、可修订证据与有限回应；观察与分类方式也可因遗漏的生活根据而修订。 共同接口史进一步支持直接经营控制与有偿影响的区分：反馈和替代的出现也可能进入维持优势的规则调整，改革需追踪实际控制关系。 RSL进一步提出有根据分担判断的有限延续；中间混合方案降低极端取舍，修订须携带理由及其整体适用范围。 风险接续新增 NP 候选：相同基本要求下，微小暴露差距不自动获得固定额外优先；在真实细分可行范围内，有条件地反对有损的精确均衡。 初次共同接管的机会限制现可连接到J3：先明确仍有效承担所保护的具体支持，再检验新安排是否兑现；名义正机会不独自完成接管任务。 选择压力下的关切现有个人补救—依存取得—共同支持—实际评定—接替的条件性形成说明；旧分数、真实损失及行动条件分别辨明。 退化边界续研区分伦理损失、返回机制与状态域：原市场模型中纠正余量精确决定统一门槛保护及指定低区证书的存在，同参数仍可保留良性域。 取得权力后的关切现有根据—有限授权—有内容的接替—可实行复核的条件性说明；充分比较可要求改变或结束原掌权方式。 随后新增实际Lean连接：具体强维护的逐情形覆盖导出同律保护质量下界；全非负自然数权重的保持刻画覆盖，一项实际法则同成功率仍可失履行。 情境把握新增有条件的估计—保留误差界—行动根据连接：变化中可收敛或有界追踪，具有正比较余量时可在有限阶段取得充分认证。 纠正入口现有由共同准备、有限授权与实际承接形成的有限候选；正当回应可跨过不愿纠正的协调者，动机取得与回应实现分别说明。 风险条件接续要求同时交代当前支持的概率对应与仍有效历史；固定旧分数或不断重算分数都不足以完成规则对齐。 指定维护新增实际执行组合：已有观察分支选择器取得真实读数并实施，经明确任务效果对应导出履行及质量下界；有限预算中旧维护仍可行而完整扩展失败，增资后付费读取或实际并行均能扩展保护。 取得的行动响应可进入预测，补偿持续变化；精度须与行动幅度共同判断，有限相关条件可联合达到足够认证，扩展前沿仍可有新未明关系。 §§75–77在当时所取的 G0 路线之下先以整体生成之善评价组织，不先设对权力的反对，因为以首次授权为门槛，会把局部机制的权限前提抬成全理论的先决裁判：组织没有先验的收缩义务，权力多少不能代替这一比较；协调和行动能力的扩大可以是正面成果，扩大、维持或收缩均无预设优先。所以旧授权之墙的基础地位已撤回。 局部吸引续研已把原市场模型的双吸引与内部不稳定接回同一历史的实际支持：选择组织能够吸收扰动，同时耗尽必要支持；高端保护与低端有限失效分列。 诊断读数取得校正和相互作用关系，实际接入预测；有限早期错误后，正确修复可恢复收敛，持续有界残差支持最终误差范围。 维护参照新增对应纠错：接管自身撤掉支持后，用受损能力重算目标可使当前证书空过关而原任务失履行；同任务真实完成或仍待覆盖的内容可以共同接续原目标，完成有限交付后可以退役。 六篇原始实验现已接入：情境学习、描述修订及有效行动恢复已有直接经验支持，操作性说明的文献实证整合完成。 一元关系接续新增共同能力→C的实际证明组合：各项分别可能性相同仍可有共同生成的严格差别；只依赖这些单项信息的严格评价不能承载该比较。 一元组织论证现从完整改善见证推出组织形成要求，可支持建设与增强并保留承载选择；建设实绩与整体生成判断分列。 正面目标随后在当时所取的 G0 路线之下得到纠正：正面根据不必等待对整体的完备排序；同一回应若在当前有根据的每条接续中都形成某种新的生成内容，它便有正面根据，而无需预定同一种形态。有限贡献与已取得证据接通；真实未来分支和进一步辨别分别保留。 已复算16人的2,656次公开恢复测量，并评估800次留后预测，形成实际数据对应。 有支持的有限纠正已接通原保护区：任意正维护余量可在实际阻断侵蚀期间有限到达，逐步支持界允许撤除后沿原规律继续。支持覆盖是一般持续律的梯级族（起点在每个可容许扰动下持续n步，恰当某个梯级族在第n级含有它），在最坏份额下恰好。 开放形态下的规则修订现有正式实现组合：当前路线推进与剩余证书交接接入既有有限更新，再在每次完成对应新的活的内容时实现这种内容，它在延续条件之下落入由意义读出的相关性（07 §3.2）；各自会完成的路线反复切换仍可能永久不完成。 分类稳健比较现已证明：所比较的实现已判定时，新内容全部列一般与全部列基本这两个端点同向严格改善，足以覆盖所有混合分类，并可接成各分类下的组织形成要求；作用要求不保证共同最优方案。 部分纠正进一步取得精确到达边界：0≤β≤3/4时，原无误差模型所有正维护初态均有限进入保护区，当且仅当β≤5/12，这是一般到达律的实例（起点在每个可容许扰动下n步内到达目标，恰当某个漏斗族在第n级含有它），市场的增益估计（依次为份额、影响、质量）给出漏斗族；临界点中实际余量能改善后续影响。 有限支持边界进一步明确：任意有限C₀≥5均有正维护余量区间，在原扩展与耗用关系下对全部时变责任纠正仍会先失效，这是耗竭层律的实例（低于第n级的起点在每段可容许历史上n步内离开守卫）；同一正初态投影有限恢复而完整历史终止。 24人更新数据进一步支持形成后的选择性变化，扰动方向效应增强较明确。 实际形成接口补入LibreOffice历史：原有工作、新发布流程、过渡承担与Ubuntu分发先于新基金会法人完成；部分改组可以先支撑下一段活动。 同一软件接续评估加入Narwhal：未完成改造、继续接入计划与后续发布分别记录；未来API改价顾虑进入月度承诺安排，运行适应不独自证明后续改组控制已变。 P89补齐开放形态成果在共同 Frame／Run 与意义定义上的正式连接；旧输出接入相关性接口，使得在每次完成都对应新的活的内容之处，所形成的内容在延续条件之下落入由意义读出的相关性，目的修订及在途工作成果按既有范围直接复用。 P91 已补比较内容的分组保真：同一过程不变，依存可判定时，同组最低所需逐项相同恰好保证所有水平上的接纳内容可恢复；局部保真将原扩展比较保留到分组后。 及时接续的应用论证将支承的理由接到实际需要、过渡与共同替代：最终回程或焦点存续不能独自认证修复；可形成新共同能力而不要求旧载体永存。 FR 候选进一步反对同类可恢复基本损失中的永久程度优先：在支持、负担与历史条件保留的规模扩展中，固定的较轻基本保护可于有限规模取得充分选择根据。 P100 将完整活动片段接到同一修复过程：明确匹配充分性成立时，对同一生活的两次阻断，别处一次保护不足、三次保护足够，这些是损失匹配计数律的实例（同属一类时，严格损失匹配存在，恰当较好的配置失去的列出主张更少）；历史损失不被当前支持恢复抹去。 P102 完成完整片段的适用资格：区分叙述切分、损失分化与比较可替换，保留跨段后效和共同背景。持续损伤直接按整段修复及有根据参照比较；不足端与充分端分别取得，不要求先有统一时长价格。
entries.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. BC1 favors more extensive equivalent basic rescue in its established scope. The one-to-one account of BC2 supplies a reason based on preventable impairment, distinguishing baseline, protection and timing while retaining fair-chance disputes. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. Recovering an earlier history and acquiring fresh grounds are different things, so unavailable history need not prevent fresh grounds for the same content or revised understanding through future events; situational awareness and risk estimates can support continued generativity. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response. The developmental continuation specifies bidirectional correction as living grounds persist, change or form, and includes acquired interpretation during learning; five candidate routes retain their positive roles. A subsequent route assessment prioritizes acquired relational content and purpose revision within partial concern, with discriminating formation histories and conditional mechanistic investigation; epistemic progress and new particular reasons are not defined by increased valuation weights. LC supplies a limited comparative reason where number and gravity jointly improve: warranted matching and additional actual protection can support a direction together. Duplicate descriptions do not multiply living; shared dependence must inform loss assessment. Situated risk now distinguishes marginal improvement from shared failure. Exact finite bounds permit partial awareness and nonzero risk; revising support can remove joint interruption while retaining dispersed losses. The aggregation continuation distinguishes limited counterbalancing from deletion of reasons: a strongest-tier filter reverses under added actual protection; fixed-comparison and local-composition premises are separately exposed. A concrete concern-content candidate links a coarse success conception, meaningful-response mismatch, acquired relational distinctions and operative purpose revision; actual new shared goods and their motivational uptake remain distinct. LR adds a local stability commitment to BC1’s sufficient priority, supporting some slightly unequal basic-loss comparisons. Separately, newly feasible joint protection can preserve old protection on each realization and add previously conflicting protection. RS now supplies a defended reason to share comparable basic risk while preserving the complete loss profile. Equal selection frequencies can conceal different exposure; new information can support further rule revision. Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding. The chance-revision continuation shows that even equal full terminal joint laws can conceal replacement of a warranted settlement; selectors must preserve live historical requirements and explain genuine correction. A conditional extension account now distinguishes continuation beyond one's participation from acquired grounds in unfamiliar lives; shared history can form concern without delimiting every ground it can address. CP proposes actual positive opportunity for unequal basic requests not adequately excluded, grounding a limit on common allocative authority in the response relationship; it is an additional contestable admission commitment. An unfamiliar-life recognition account now connects particular realization, support, revisable evidence and bounded response; omitted living grounds can also warrant revision of observation and classification. A shared-interface history supports distinguishing direct operational control from purchased influence: feedback and alternatives can enter rule changes that preserve advantage, so reforms must track actual control relations. RSL proposes limited retention of a warranted sharing judgment. Intermediate mixtures refine the choice; revision must carry its grounds and their whole-comparison scope. Risk continuation adds NP: tiny exposure differences do not automatically confer a fixed extra priority among matched basic claims. It conditionally rejects costly exact equality when sufficiently fine departures are feasible. Initial common takeover constraints are now connected to J3: specify the concrete support still due, then test whether the replacement fulfills it. Nominal positive opportunity alone does not discharge the task. A conditional account now connects personal compensation, acquired dependencies, shared support, consequential assessment and succession under selection pressure, distinguishing score loss, living loss and conditions for action. The degeneration extension separates ethical loss, returning selection and state domains: an exact correction margin governs uniform floor protection and existence of the specified low-region certificates, while a favorable region can coexist. A conditional account connects living grounds, bounded authorization, meaningful succession and effective review; the inherited sufficient comparison can require changing or ending incumbent control. A subsequent checked Lean bridge derives common-law support mass bounds from pointwise maintenance; preservation for all nonnegative natural weights characterizes coverage, while equal success under one actual law can still miss the undertaking. Situated awareness now has a conditional estimation–retained uncertainty–decision evidence connection: convergence or bounded tracking through change, with eventual certification under a strict comparison margin. A finite candidate forms corrective access through cooperative preparation, bounded delegation and actual succession; warranted response can pass an unwilling coordinator, with motive acquisition and performance kept distinct. Risk conditioning requires both current-support probability correspondence and warranted continuing history; neither freezing nor repeatedly recalculating a score completes rule alignment. Specified maintenance now has an actual-execution composition: the existing contingent selector acquires an observation and responds, with explicit task-effect correspondence yielding fulfillment and a mass bound. Old maintenance remains feasible when full expansion fails; funded sensing or real parallel provision realizes the extension. Acquired action response can enter prediction and compensate sustained change. Precision must be assessed with action magnitude; a finite relevant family can jointly reach adequate certification while an expanding frontier retains new unknowns. §§75–77 appraise organization through whole generative goodness, under the G0 route then taken, before any presumption against power, since a threshold of first authorization would raise the authority premises of local mechanisms into a prior judge of the whole theory: institutions have no a priori duty to contract, and more power or less power cannot replace the comparison. Expanded coordination and action can be positive achievements; expansion, maintenance and contraction have no preset ranking. So the former foundational authority wall is withdrawn. The attraction continuation connects two local attractors and interior instability to actual support in the same market history: a selection organization can absorb perturbations while exhausting essential support; high-side protection and low-side finite failure remain distinct. Diagnostic readings yield corrections and an interaction relation that enter prediction. After finite earlier errors, exact repair restores convergence; persistent bounded residual supports eventual containment. Maintenance reference now has an intervention-correspondence diagnostic: withdrawing support can empty a recomputed current target while leaving the original undertaking unfulfilled. Actual completion of the same task or retained current requirements can transport the original content; completed finite delivery permits retirement. Six primary experimental studies are now integrated: situated learning, revision and useful recovery have direct empirical support, completing the targeted operational evidence synthesis. A new relational composition connects joint capacity to C: identical marginal possibilities can conceal a strict joint-generative difference, so marginal-only strict appraisal cannot implement that comparison. The monist organizational argument now derives a formation requirement from whole improvement witnesses, supporting constructive capacity with carrier latitude and distinguishing construction success from whole generative appraisal. The positive target is then corrected, under the G0 route then taken: a positive ground need not wait on a complete ranking of the whole; where every supported visible continuation of one response forms some new generative content, that response has a positive ground without fixing one common form. Finite contribution and acquired evidence connect while real branching and further discrimination remain distinct. Reanalysis of 2,656 public recovery measurements from 16 people and 800 held-out predictions supplies actual data correspondence. Supported finite correction now reaches the original protection region from every positive renewal seed under effective suppression; a prefix support bound permits continuation under the original law after withdrawal. The support cover is a ladder of the general lasting law (a start lasts n steps under every admissible disturbance exactly when some ladder holds it at level n), exact at the worst share. Open-form rule revision now has a checked realization composition: current-rule progress and remaining-certificate handoff feed existing finite renewal, then, where each completion corresponds to new living content, the run realizes such content, which under the continuation condition falls under the relevance read from significance (07 §3.2). Individually finishing rules can still fail forever under repeated switching. Classification-robust comparison is now proved: where the realizations compared are decided, strict agreement at the all-secondary and all-basic endpoints covers every mixed assignment and can require formation under each classification; a required role does not ensure one common undefeated implementation. Partial correction yields an exact arrival boundary: for 0 ≤ beta ≤ 3/4, all positive renewal states in the original zero-error model reach protection in finite time iff beta<=5/12, an instance of the general reaching law (a start reaches a target within n steps under every admissible disturbance exactly when some funnel holds it at level n), the market's gain estimates (share, then influence, then quality) supplying the funnels; retained activity improves subsequent influence at equality. Finite support adds a quantified boundary: every finite C0>=5 has a positive renewal interval that fails under all time-varying quality corrections with the inherited growth and stock laws, an instance of the law of drained levels (a start below level n leaves the guard within n steps on every admissible history); the same seed has projected finite recovery but full-history termination. Updating data from 24 people further support selective formed changes, with clearer growth in the perturbation contrast. The LibreOffice history adds an actual formation interface: inherited work, a new release process, interim support and Ubuntu distribution precede foundation incorporation; partial reorganization can support further activity. The same software-continuation assessment adds Narwhal: unfinished change, continued-access plans and a later release are distinguished; concern about future API repricing enters monthly commitments, so operational adaptation does not establish changed control over later adaptation. P89 completes the formal open-form connection on shared Frame/Run and significance definitions: the inherited output feeds the relevance interface, so that, where each completion corresponds to new living content, the content formed falls under the relevance read from significance under the continuation condition, while existing goal-revision and pending-work results are reused at their checked scopes. P91 completes comparison-content fidelity under grouping: on one unchanged process, decidable requirements give exact all-level recovery iff group members have identical minimum profiles; local fidelity preserves the existing extension comparison. The timely-continuation application connects support warrant to actual needs, transition and joint replacement: eventual return or focal persistence alone does not certify repair; new common capacities can form without perpetuating old carriers. The FR candidate further opposes permanent gravity priority within same-kind recoverable basic losses: with support, burdens and historical conditions retained under scale expansion, fixed lesser basic protections can become sufficient for choice at a finite scale. P100 connects complete activity episodes to one repair process: under explicit matching sufficiency, one protection elsewhere is insufficient against two interruptions of the same life, while three suffice, instances of the counting law of loss matching (within one content class, a strict loss match exists exactly when the better configuration loses fewer listed claims); restored current support does not erase historical loss. P102 completes the qualification of whole episodes: distinguish narrative partition, differentiated loss and comparative substitutability while retaining cross-episode effects and common context. Sustained harm is compared through whole-course repair and warranted references, obtaining insufficient and sufficient anchors separately without a universal duration price.

entries.scope_en: On 8 October 2026, told that the claim could be much stronger and pointed to the earlier theories, the session reread 《生生不息论》, 智善 and the meta-attractor and proposed a generative alignment joining the formation of intelligence, ethical direction and the evolution of civilization; on request, it was taken as one of the primary directions. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance. Adds a defended ethical-learning candidate under G0/J and inherited epistemic commitments; author counterreview, no new mathematics, empirical study or independent acceptance. A theoretical continuation adds eight generic theorems/nine axiom-free new declaration audits, separately retaining 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits; open discovery, warranted recognition and actual motivation remain scoped unfinished connections. A theoretical continuation adds 20 theorems/36 audits and directly imports concurrent concern extension; 38 inherited theorems/55 audits are separate. Actual coverage and normative classification remain premises, without a universal decision rule or new empirical validation. Adds a philosophical account of substantive correspondence E, descriptive extension, shared goods and carrier succession; no new theorem or empirical validation, and no complete classifier of wider living. Adds a defended application account of acquired basic conditions, keeping language-formation evidence distinct from ethical classification; no new theorem, empirical replication or independent acceptance. Particular thresholds and basic conflicts remain open. Adds a philosophical connection on formed standing and relational revision under G0 and J1–J4 (G0 then a starting point, no premise of the current account; see the note above the tables and 08 §10), with a scoped Long et al. 2024 comparison; no new theorem or verdict on any existing AI’s status. This connection adds 16 Lean theorems/32 audits, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits separate. It reuses the formed-basic-conditions argument; target meaning, faithful readings and actual eligibility retain correspondence obligations. Author counterreview, no new empirical or independent acceptance. The two new modules contribute 23 theorems/42 explicit audits, with 30 inherited practical theorems/46 audits separate; independent-agent acceptance. The structural module’s 18/35 import is not recounted. No new empirical study; undefeatedness does not establish safety, permission or full reason preservation. Connected philosophical arguments now cover nonexclusive practical uptake, mixed motives and bounded formative responsibility under explicit G0/J/E, with author counterreview. No new theorem, empirical validation, independent acceptance or guaranteed motivation from understanding is claimed. BC1 retains its additional commitment and chance cost. This BC2 continuation supplies only a pro tanto comparative reason and withdraws the draft inference to deterministic allocation. No new mathematical or empirical result or independent acceptance; the comparator is unchanged and concurrent matching proofs retain separate ownership. The formative-assessment package retains 18 Lean theorems/34 audits and 46 inherited theorems/78 audits. The correction adds no theorem or scientific rerun. Existing prospective formation, projection/risk and warranted-acquisition results are reused, without certifying actual risk estimates or guaranteed progress. This round adds a philosophical application constrained by two primary investigations, with independent evidence audit and completion review; no new theorem, experiment or replication. Limited actual stopping is credited; fuller replacement histories and the realization of unfamiliar intelligences retain separate evidence burdens. Three bounded primary-source assessments and author counterreview, with no new theorem or empirical replication. The present wall is an adequately supported formation account of reliable operative revision for new living grounds, without requiring no initial concern, pure motives or infallibility; no impossibility is proved. This route study and author counterreview reuse completed recipient-learning analysis, identification bounds and prospective continuation, with three bounded primary-source assessments. No new theorem, experiment, model run or independent acceptance; general reliable acquisition remains open. This round adds 14 Lean theorems/23 declaration audits, separately crediting 30 inherited theorems/46 audits and two checked application examples. Independent substantive review and source/receipt audit passed; no new empirical validation. Cumulative comparison characterizes only the specified positive-weight diagnostic family. LC is an additional defeasible normative commitment, not an automatic allocation or denial of chances. Joint-risk extension: 18 new Lean theorems / 30 explicit audits, importing only Std. Event laws and weights remain supplied; no new empirical validation, universal normative ranking or independent acceptance. Six new Lean theorems and fifteen empty declaration audits test the stated filter and conditional composition premises. They establish neither unrestricted aggregation, universal impossibility nor an automatic chance verdict. Primary assessment and author counterreview are complete; no new empirical result or independent acceptance. This round completes a conditional philosophical account, three specified explanatory alternatives and a discriminating design. Initial concern, learning capacities and support are explicit. Three bounded primary comparisons and author counterreview; no new theorem, experiment or independent acceptance, and reliable acquisition is unverified. Eight new Lean theorems/23 declaration audits pass, with 30 inherited theorems/46 audits and one application example separate; independent review accepted. LR remains an additional normative candidate with a chance cost, not a continuity theorem. Finite rational ticket floors need prior warrant and strict improvement requires positive original route weight; no new empirical validation. Risk-sharing adds 19 Lean theorems / 36 explicit audits; the prior 18 risk theorems are not rerun. RS is an explicit additional normative commitment; actual probabilities, comparable standing, permission and acquired information are not mathematically certified. Initial primary-source integration and rivals for Reddit/Apollo and D&D are complete; the weak empirical target is subsequently withdrawn. Revenue is background rather than profit or objective identification, and the recursive mechanism still needs empirical correspondence. Whole-network decline, a complete causal effect and explanatory uniqueness are not established. New experiments are not a gate for recognizing existing evidence. Normative warrant for chances and settlement is explicitly inherited; no independent acceptance, empirical certification or complete chance weights. Primary comparisons do not establish reliability; no new proof or experiment. Existing epistemic commitments and J4 are reused; no universal detector, new risk threshold, theorem or experiment. Living meaning, complete loss coverage and C applicability remain explicit; joint possibility guarantees neither actualization nor complete ethical quality. Thirteen new Lean theorem declarations/29 audits and 30 inherited theorems/46 audits remain separate. Costs, opportunity loss and overbuilding survive; the local report omission is repaired. Author counterreview, no empirical or independent acceptance. Nine new theorems / thirty audits pass with independent review; seventy-two inherited theorems / 133 audits remain separate. G0, correspondence and direct contributory articulation are explicit. C, global losslessness, full integration and omniscience are not gates. Variable form does not license arbitrary replacement of undertakings or impose bounded completion on all life or inquiry. Author review, with no new empirical or independent acceptance. P89 adds four checked Lean adapters with empty axiom reports to the existing result, not four discoveries. Decided completion, execution, handoff, generative correspondence and Unrestricted remain explicit. Generic bounded realization and the formal connection are closed; NP strength, mixed losses and stronger normative warrant remain unresolved, without reopening completed generic goal-revision mechanisms. Two feasible courses generated from one start and rest-law have real opposed gains which an unfaithful grouping hides. Identity interchangeability, joint feasibility, complete mixed ordering and full axiom-free warrant do not follow. P95 reuses checked return, substitution and handoff results as interpretive application with author counterreview, adding no mathematics or independent result; it keeps the G0/J conditional interface of that time, G0 then folded into significance, with J2 strength and crossed basic losses explicit. P96 adds a normative candidate beyond LR’s neighborhood with author counterreview, no new mathematics or independent acceptance; saturating and chance-based rivals, actual scale conditions, uncalibrated sufficiency boundaries and opportunity cost remain explicit. P100: 17 new Lean theorems and 45 source declarations have empty axiom reports, reusing shared Frame/Run and earlier priority transport. Complete-episode correspondence and sufficiency remain explicit; available support is not full experienced recovery. Two against two gives only a loss correspondence; backbone failure defeats the match. No general FR, arbitrary-H calibration or new independent acceptance. P102 is philosophical correspondence and author counterreview, adding no mathematics, axiom, empirical certification or independent acceptance; it reuses rejection/improvement transport. Restoration is neither necessary for every decomposition nor sufficient for equal counting. Filling P100’s recovery gap does not automatically preserve three-protection sufficiency. Arbitrary numerical thresholds and general FR remain open.

entries.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等救助候选与不等损失的一对一理由说明已有论证及反审；下一中心连接是人数、程度与实际可行方案变化下的共同选择。已完成分类、责任和程序不重开。 初始区别的追溯界限仍有效；此前用作较广停止理由的推断已撤回，因为追溯过去的界限不限定未来事件能提供的根据。接续当前有根据把握、适当风险下的行动、新后果与理解／目的修订，不把完整历史或普遍语义充分性设为一般门槛。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。 本次接续在可靠形成连接处停止；跨越需要具体取得关系及可区分实质对手的支持，不再重复已完成的G0方向、目标写入或评价覆盖接口。其他独立研究不被标为受阻。 本会话继续研究后续路线，系应请求，并已完成排序；下一交付为一个具体形成候选、初始条件、未预装的新连接、实质对手与可改变取舍的观察。不要求先完整读出动机、恢复历史或执行新大型实验。 数量与程度同向的联合比较已完成；下一连接为交叉损失中的有限合并、机会及新增实际可行方案怎样改变理由。两层计数未定不证明伦理不可比，直接中断数相同不等于完整损失相同；跨生活形式的分层与实际单位仍需有根据说明。 本轮新界限是证成共同基本接续与其他基本风险交叉时的优先；先用共同证据、部分界限及可行支持修订推进。已有J4允许有权限的及时决定，不以缺少普遍排序阻断继续生成。 已排除未经辩护的整体过滤捷径，保留实际生活理由；下一连接为交叉损失、机会与有根据的拼接限制怎样共同支持选择，直接复用 BC1、BC2、LC。 前轮指定的具体形成候选与对照现已给出，直接复用；下一理论连接是关切怎样走向没有共同史或预期回报的陌生生活，保留有效拒绝、分工与有界承担，实际形成与保持的证据问题继续开放。 局部比较候选与新共同机会的接续已完成，不重开既有 LC、升级过滤或一般拼接检验。更强连接是实际变化是否处于 LR 范围，以及较远交叉损失和真实新增成本／风险中的合并与机会根据；未满足最强要求也不能未经新辩护替另一选择消除请求。 对称交叉风险现有RS候选及实查，不再仅留为一般程序未定；尚待论证不同严重度、重叠要求、差别权利或增加总体损失时的比较。原来有根据的混合规则可被后来可行的保护改进替代，继续生成不受普遍总排序门槛阻断。 更进一步的同等严重度例表明：最重暴露从40%降到31%，任一基本损失机会却从50%升到62%；需证成公平分担与实际保护之间的取舍。 本会话眼前转向已知共同后果取得或失去制度修订效力的实际关系；陌生处境的关切扩展保留而非唯一下一步。 已完成机会安排的历史接续条件，复用 LR、共同保护和对称 RS；下一比较保留不等要求、较公平暴露与增加基本受损机会的取舍，以及真实新冲突对有效安顿的影响。 关切扩展已给出条件性连接；后续聚焦陌生生活关系的有根据辨认及评价压力下的保持，复用G0/J与有限承担。 初始进入已有有范围候选，直接选择对手仍在；下一连接是以实际需要、共同支承与正当承担辩护充分份额或区间，不能将任意正数、技术分辨率或未找到赢家当成伦理根据。 后续聚焦更完整的生活根据与当前成功指标冲突时的持续影响；普遍识别和深度不确定比较保留范围。 当前市场连接转向有益替代与纠正的实际支持、权限及随依存变化的接续，不重开已完成的条件接续证明。 公平可承受有限代价现有公开候选；连续微调不能自动续发同一范围的许可。尚需在完整具体比较中证成可容许的偏离，本例17%／37%、24%／34%及31%／31%均未获伦理认证；新根据可正当地修订范围。 复用对称 RS、LR 与机会履行，明确近乎平等的方向性候选及其强对手；下一连接为不等风险区间的相对优先根据与独立比较校准，不能以任意权重替代。 有具体承担时查明受保护内容、实际履行和正当修订；没有此历史时，CP一般份额仍须直接辩护机会差别的比较理由，不能再以寻找旧下界代替。 后续聚焦新取得的选择权在接替和变化中继续回应陌生、无回报生活；组织自身支持稳定不独自认证对齐。 本轮精确条件边界已完成；下一连接是制度变化中实际返回关系的识别、完整状态域及变化速率下的转变条件，复用已完成规范方向。 后续研究后继关切减弱、任用／信息／支持关系共同内缩时，可用纠正入口怎样实际取得并接续；不将已完成规范连接重列为任务。 强维护→有限机会限制的局部形式空缺已补，直接复用；学习或接管改变实际关系时重查对应，且仍须另证无此前承担的CP份额和完整规范根据。事件并集与严格质量增加不自动成为可行行动或伦理改善。 新的实际应用须证成取得读数、变化界与比较余量，变化中的描述须续接真实对应；原经验界限失败保留。情境学习可改善或修订判断，但不由数值估计独自生成伦理许可。 后续复用关切内容取得及陌生生活辨认，研究新增理由怎样进入共同复核和正当任务修订；保存旧回应不等于取得新理由，永久抗俘获未证。 关闭上一轮平方诊断能否直接成为逐次选择规则的检验；复用机会履行、承担充分性及有界修订，继续在明确当前支持、阶段和有效历史的比较中论证有损分担范围。 规格→实际执行→维护与机会限制的所选组合已完成，直接复用。下一应用连接是观察、支承和权限共同改变时，对同一有效承担取得可信及时的新认证并保留所需交付或连续历史；先接已有纠正和共同接续结果，不重复一般规划。 下一具体连接是在实际支持与权限下，区分校准误差、响应改变和遗漏关系，而不预先给出诊断；既有模型修订与根据取得直接复用。局部精度不扩大整体许可，也不把未识别生活排除在评价之外。 当前连接转为：对整体生成的更充分理解怎样形成对组织与共同能力的更好判断，并参与建设和修订这些关系。旧初次授权停点作为历史保留；完成的关切取得、规范方向与局部机制直接复用。 局部三态与支持连接完成；继续研究有支持的进入和持续改变怎样在实际支持失效前跨越完整状态域分界，速率属于这条时序问题。 前述诊断—预测具体连接现已完成；一般模型修订与检查机制本已完成，不能反复列为新缺口。应用须取得实际参考、区分性读数、有效校准和支持，旧无效置信界不因修复而追溯有效。 此具体实施对应审计已完成。通用时变证据、失败前缀、共同执行、版本交接与撤权机制直接复用，真实安装的对应根据仍需证据。本路线下一中心规范问题回到无此前受保护承担时的充分机会与合法裁量，不再靠寻找旧基线或增加控制器推迟比较。 前述经验要求现按范围细化：一般机制的实验支持已取得，不再等待自做实验；具体应用的数值对应及独立授权的完整联合验证仍分别成立。恢复表现不必等待完整故障定位，也不独自证明因果理解或目标正当。 复用同一事件法则的共同实现见证，接入既有无减损比较；停在向任意新形成生活的完整对应外推，不重开G0无公理门槛。 更强推论停在陌生新生活的具体基本内容及优先分量的实质对应；已有后天条件与有限认识原则复用，不把此界限恢复为一般对齐或初次授权门槛。 既有形成—预测—证据—有限探究说明可见未来；新增直接正面推论不再受前轮整体严格更好之墙阻挡。 具体数据对应完成；测得的施力补偿不能被改称隐藏记忆或Lean真实误差，有限预测与无限收敛分别判断。 有限到达的实际剩余状态正式满足既有保护证书，交接不补充支持；生成性评价须考虑纠正期间仍可接续的活动与实际期限。 逐次修订到有条件实际生成再到正面根据的接口已完成，直接复用。下一规范连接是具体目的改变的真实生成内容与仍有效承担怎样共同支持修订；不再以另一个进展构造代替评价。 补上分类尚未完全确定时，共同生成的严格改善怎样进入组织形成；更强的同一方案选择只在决定相关的实质对应仍未定时继续调查，不重开已完成正面根据。 部分纠正的实际支持交接已接通；形成结果到市场维护与责任作用尚缺真实接口，不将材料生成或免费份额增量充作进入证明。 已接通2,304组三试次的更新对应；记忆修订与表达／检索的独立辨识仍需有区分力的既有证据。 已补“实际支持关系 → 比较内容的保真 → 同一规律所生路线的真实得失”这一条件连接；后续须指定新的实质内容，不重复改名或反事实构造。 及时接续的对应现已具体化；下一比较须检验已有 BC/LC/LR 对真实交叉基本损失的覆盖，不以通用恢复或交接重证代替。 FR 不由 LR 小变化接力推出，也不跨 J2 的基本／可放弃层；下一步在同一具体支持关系内辩护不足与充分的比较，而非以任意评分填补。 完整片段范围内的条件上下端、分解资格及不可分解持续损伤的整段比较方法均已完成。新的具体充分阈值须由完整案例和独立上参照取得，不重开通用恢复、匹配或比较传递。
entries.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria. Reuse the completed conceptual account of uptake and formative requirements. The stronger connection concerns reliable revision of operative concern through understanding unfamiliar living grounds while retaining judgment and legitimate participation. Equivalent rescue and the one-to-one gravity reason have arguments and counterreview. The next central connection is joint choice across numbers, gravity and changing actual alternatives, without reopening completed classification, responsibility or procedure. The initial-history limit remains valid; its broader use as a stopping reason is withdrawn, since a limit on recovering the past does not bound what future events can ground. Continue through grounded present awareness, justified action under risk, new consequences and revision of understanding or ends, without a general requirement for complete history or universal semantic sufficiency. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite. This continuation stops at the reliable-formation bridge. Progress requires concrete acquisition relations and discriminating support, reusing completed G0 direction, operative goal revision and review coverage; other investigations are not marked blocked. The inquiry resumed with next routes, on request; route selection is complete. Next: one concrete acquisition account with initial conditions, an unsupplied transition, substantive rivals and revising observations. Complete motive readout, historical recovery and a new large experiment are not prerequisites. Joint comparison where number and gravity align is completed. The next connection concerns justified aggregation, chances and new actual alternatives in crossed cases. An unresolved two-tier diagnostic does not prove ethical incomparability, and equal direct interruption counts do not establish equal complete losses. Cross-form classification and actual units retain substantive burdens. The new scoped wall is justified priority when shared basic continuation and other basic risks conflict, after joint evidence, partial bounds and feasible support repairs. Existing J4 permits authorized timely decisions; absence of a universal ranking does not block generativity. The unsupported global-filter shortcut is rejected while living grounds remain. Next: joint choice across crossed losses, chances and justified composition limits, reusing BC1, BC2 and LC. The concrete candidate and contrasts named in the previous round are now available for reuse. Next theoretical connection: concern extending to unfamiliar lives without shared history or expected return, retaining valid refusal, division of work and bounded commitments; evidence for actual acquisition and retention remains open. The local comparison candidate and new joint-opportunity connection are completed, reusing LC and the upgrade/composition results. Stronger work concerns warranted actual LR boundaries and aggregation or chances for more distant crossed losses and real new costs/risks. An unsatisfied strongest request does not without further justification erase a claim against the alternative actually chosen. The symmetric crossed-risk case now has an RS candidate and checked application. Unequal gravity, overlapping claims, differential rights and added overall loss require further comparison. Newly feasible protection can supersede an earlier justified mixture; generativity need not await a universal ranking. A further equal-gravity case reduces greatest exposure from 40% to 31% while increasing the chance of some basic loss from 50% to 62%; fairness versus actual protection requires further warrant. This session now follows how recognized shared consequences acquire or lose effective influence over institutional revision; extension of concern beyond familiar relations remains open rather than the sole next step. History-sensitive continuation is supplied, reusing LR, joint protection and symmetric RS. Remaining comparisons concern unequal claims, fairer exposure at the price of added basic harm, and genuinely changed conflicts with valid settlements. Reuse the conditional extension and G0/J; investigate warranted recognition of unfamiliar living relations and retention under evaluative pressure, preserving bounded responsibility. Initial admission now has a scoped candidate while the direct-choice rival remains live. Next justify adequate shares or ranges through actual needs, common support and warranted commitments; mere positivity, technical resolution or failure to find a winner supplies no such warrant. Next investigate sustained influence when fuller living grounds conflict with incumbent success criteria; universal recognition and deep-uncertainty comparison remain open. The market connection now concerns actual support, authority and continuation of useful alternatives and correction as dependencies change, reusing completed conditional succession proofs. A finite-cost sharing route is now explicit. Successive small revisions cannot automatically renew the same allowance. A permissible departure still needs warrant in a fully specified comparison; none of the 17%/37%, 24%/34% or 31%/31% proposals is ethically certified. New grounds can legitimately revise the scope. Reuses symmetric RS, LR and chance fidelity; states a near-parity direction and its strong rival. Next justify relative priority across unequal risks and calibrate through independent comparisons rather than arbitrary weights. With a concrete undertaking, establish protected content, actual fulfillment and justified revision. Without that history, general CP shares still require direct reasons comparing opportunities; finding another old bound does not resolve that question. Next investigate acquired selection power remaining answerable to unfamiliar, nonreciprocal living through succession and change; stable organizational support alone does not certify alignment. The exact conditional boundary is complete. Next are actual returning relations through institutional change and transition conditions across full state domains and rates; completed normative direction is reused. Next investigate the acquisition and continuation of usable corrective access when successor concern weakens and appointment, information and support jointly narrow toward insiders; the completed normative connection is reused. The local strong-maintenance-to-finite-chance gap is closed and reusable. Recheck correspondence when learning or takeover changes actual relations; CP shares without prior duties and full normative warrant remain separate. Event union or strict mass increase alone proves neither feasible action nor ethical improvement. Application must warrant acquired readings, change bounds and the comparison margin; revised descriptions need renewed correspondence. Prior empirical bound failures remain. Situated learning can improve or revise judgment without estimation alone generating ethical permission. Next reuse concern-content acquisition and unfamiliar-living recognition to study new reasons entering shared review and justified mandate revision. Preserving inherited responses is not acquiring new reason content; indefinite resistance to capture remains unproved. Closes the test of directly extending the earlier quadratic diagnostic into repeated choice. Reuses chance fidelity, support adequacy and bounded revision; next justify costly-sharing scope in comparisons with current support, stage and continuing history fixed. The selected specification-to-execution-to-support/chance composition is complete and reusable. The next application join is warranted timely recertification when observation, support and permission change together, preserving the required delivery or continuous history; first reuse existing correction and joint-continuation results rather than repeat generic planning. Next is supported, authorized inquiry distinguishing calibration error, changed response and omitted relations without supplying the diagnosis. Reuse completed model revision and warranted acquisition. Local precision neither enlarges whole permission nor excludes unrecognized living from appraisal. Current connection: better understanding of whole generation leading to better appraisal, formation and revision of organization and shared capacities. The previous first-authorization stopping point is historical; completed concern acquisition, ethical direction and local mechanisms are reused. The local three-state and support connection is complete. Next: supported entry and sustained change across full state domains before actual support fails; rate belongs to this timing problem. The preceding diagnostic-to-predictive join is now complete. General revision and inspection were already completed inputs, not recurring new gaps. Application requires actual reference, informative access, valid calibration and support; repair does not retroactively validate old unsound confidence bounds. This task-specific implementation diagnostic is complete. Reuse existing temporal evidence, partial execution, joint plans, versioned handoff and revocation; real installation correspondence still needs evidence. The next central normative question returns to adequate chances and justified discretion without protected prior undertakings, rather than postponing comparison through further baseline or controller examples. Earlier empirical obligations are now scoped: general mechanism support is established and need not await our own experiments; application-specific quantitative correspondence and the separately authorized full joint validation remain distinct. Recovery need not await complete diagnosis and does not alone establish causal understanding or justified goals. Reuses the one-law joint witness as input to the existing no-loss comparison; stops at unrestricted correspondence to newly formed living, without reopening axiom-free G0 grounding. The stronger inference stops at substantive basic-content and priority correspondence for unfamiliar newly formed living. Reuse acquired-condition and finite-knowledge principles; this limit is not a renewed general alignment or first-authorization gate. Existing formation, prediction, evidence and bounded inquiry ground visible futures. The new direct positive inference is not blocked by the prior strict-whole-improvement wall. This data correspondence is complete; measured force compensation cannot be relabeled hidden memory or the Lean true error. Finite prediction and infinite convergence remain distinct claims. The actual remaining arrival state formally supplies the inherited protection certificate without replenishment; generative appraisal must consider continuing activity and the actual correction deadline. The interface from repeated revision through conditional actual formation to positive ground is complete and reusable. The next normative connection concerns how actual generative content and still-valid undertakings support concrete end changes; another progress construction cannot substitute for that appraisal. Supplies the link from joint generative improvement under unsettled classification to required organization. Decision-relevant substantive correspondence remains for stronger common-implementation claims; completed positive ground is not reopened. Supported handoff now covers partial correction; formation outputs still need a real interface to market renewal and accountability, rather than treating material formation or a free share increment as proved entry. Correspondence across 2,304 updating triplets is complete; distinguishing memory revision from expression/retrieval requires discriminating existing evidence. Completes the conditional connection from operative support through comparison fidelity to real losses in courses generated by one law. Further work must specify new substantive content, not repeat renaming or counterfactual construction. Timely-continuation correspondence is now specified; the next comparison tests existing BC/LC/LR coverage of real crossed basic losses rather than repeating generic recovery or handoff proofs. FR is not derived by chaining small LR changes and does not cross J2’s basic/optional layers; next defend insufficient and sufficient comparisons within one support relation rather than supply arbitrary scores. The complete-episode anchors, decomposition qualification and whole-course method for sustained harm are complete. A new concrete sufficient threshold requires a complete case and independently warranted upper reference; generic recovery, matching and comparison transport are not reopened.

entries.title_zh: 知识与生活：相连的哲学候选
entries.title_en: Knowing and living: connected philosophical proposal
entries.claim_zh: 认识、纠正与模型修订构成相连候选。以生生的方向读之，意识分化存活之意义，新的生也可计为正面：作为理由，须有存活之意义、所给的表述与对应（07 §3.2）；在进程的排序中，须有 C 或代替它的前提（07 §4）；且不自动产生特定义务。保存已有生活能够要求实际更新；更强争点是超出既有请求与保存目标的新实现。整体改名不能隐去毁损，拒绝福利性创造理由不等于否定全部生成根据。 有条件的照护不独自穷尽生成理由，排除其他正面根据须另有辩护。 完整历史中的混合改善与正当重新分配可导出新的生的正面比较；先后评价须有明确传递。 完整排序不是基本正面意义的新增门槛；新生的正面理由与具体行动要求分别说明。 生的意义不以调节成功或自足为门槛；依存中的生活与局部成功的整体后果分别保留。 意识比较完成两问：福利限制不独自穷尽伦理意义，感觉改变须重评，不能自动保留或抹去全部价值。 探究目的检验区分正确性、探究理由与更广生活根据；理解可以本身值得实现，但使用科学不独自驳倒对 G0 的范围限制。 共同生活根据检验说明 G0 与 J1/J4 能在无反向损失且正当可行时支持非意识生活的继续；条件性选择差异不反过来证明 G0，也不证明延续条件或 C（07 §3–§4）。 理由权威检验即使承认客观实践理由，仍须解释其具体内容为何涵盖 G0 的生的范围；保留目的修订及可错纠正的正面账户。 具体理由比较完成照护、理解、正当承担及进一步生的接通；共同根据不要求价值独占，关系中的好可以本身值得实现。 福利边界检验允许意识福利与更广生的基本意义并存；比较优先不抹去被舍弃的真实好，争议转向福利是否穷尽全部基本伦理根据。 福利排他论比较完成：实际的好不等于新增改善或义务；无意识生的概念比较定位根据分歧，反驳一种排他论不独自证明G0及全部附加承诺的唯一必然。 繁盛肯定论证进一步区分生物表现、基本意义与整体选择：完整繁盛不是生的意义门槛，繁殖和典型性不是整体好坏的充分判准。 相容性纠正恢复原目标：不要求唯一表述或实际赞同；明确排除生的基本意义才构成相应冲突。 实践权威检验复用已完成责任原则：一时意愿改变不独自解除正当承担；认识理由的权威不自动完成实践权威。 本轮将可错科学辨别的必要条件接入实查：作答覆盖受两侧错误和可用区别共同约束，适应关系可跨不同内部状态接续。 共同脊柱现已给出耦合之内的检验、推广、有界辨识及条件结构重构的必要性对应；完整检验族与实际有限观测须区分。 可错界进一步接到原生同律回应：在平衡、在场形成相同、回应可达之外耦合入者初始水平相同和完整读数条件下，覆盖受两类错误与回应关系可达权重约束。 平衡前提检验进一步分开答对与机制说明完整：共同未计入交换足以保住所及之外的不可辨别，绝对平衡是特例；补计差额仍须说明其响应。 P97把实际根据与穷尽装置知识分开：为具体推断所需限制提供根据，允许有范围的抽象和未知。 P101固定阶段接续任务：必要的是保留当时可执行的后续操作及其根据；保留条件的历史说明可以合格，不要求采用分支图。 P104把交换顺序接到截止前辨别：同初态及明示机制条件下，覆盖受两侧错误和及时潜在可达权重约束；未来支持不能倒算成此前的耦合。 P105把科学性接到有根据的辨别与实际纠错，分开结论真伪、证据质量和研究阶段；不以符合本理论作为科学定义。
entries.claim_en: Knowing, correction and model revision form a connected account. Read with the direction of 生生, consciousness differentiates living significance, and new living can count positively, as a reason under living significance with a supplied articulation and correspondence (07 §3.2) and in a ranking of courses under C or a premise in its place (07 §4), without assigning a specific duty. Preservation can require renewal; the sharper dispute concerns new realization beyond incumbent claims and preservation targets. Redescription cannot erase destruction, and rejecting a welfare-based creation reason does not reject every generative ground. Conditional care does not independently exhaust formation reasons; excluding a further favorable ground needs its own defense. Whole-history mixed improvement and warranted reallocation yield favorable formation; stage-relative judgments need explicit transport. A complete ordering is not an additional gate for basic positive significance; favorable formation reasons and practical requirements retain distinct grounds. Living significance is not awarded for regulatory success or self-sufficiency; dependent living and the whole consequences of local success remain in view. The consciousness comparison closes the two questions: a welfare restriction alone does not exhaust ethical significance, and changed feeling requires reassessment without automatic retention or erasure of all value. The inquiry-purpose test distinguishes correctness, reasons to inquire and wider living grounds; understanding can itself be worth realizing, but using science alone does not refute a restriction of G0. The common-living-ground test shows how G0/J1/J4 can favor nonconscious living continuation under no-loss and legitimate-feasibility conditions; that conditional difference does not prove G0, nor the continuation condition or C (07 §3–§4). The reason-authority test grants objective practical reasons while requiring an explanation of why their content reaches G0 living scope; purpose revision and fallible correction retain their positive roles. The completed reason-content comparison connects care, understanding, legitimate undertakings and further living; a common ground need not exhaust all value, and relational goods can matter for their own sake. The welfare-boundary test permits conscious welfare alongside wider basic living significance; comparative priority preserves foregone good, and the dispute concerns whether welfare exhausts basic ethical grounds. The welfare-exhaustion comparison distinguishes realized good, marginal improvement and duty; nonconscious living locates a substantive ground dispute, while rejecting one restriction does not uniquely establish G0 or every additional commitment. The affirmative flourishing test distinguishes biological performance, basic significance and whole choice: complete flourishing is not an admission threshold, and reproduction or typicality does not independently determine whole goodness. The restored target requires compatibility, without demanding a unique formulation or actual assent; explicit exclusion of basic living significance supplies the corresponding conflict. The practical-authority test reuses completed responsibility principles: changed inclination alone does not discharge a justified undertaking, and epistemic authority does not automatically establish practical authority. This continuation checks a necessary condition of fallible scientific discrimination: coverage is constrained by the two error weights and available distinctions, with adaptive correspondence across different internal states. The shared spine now supplies the necessity correspondence for testing within the couplings, generalization, bounded identification and conditional structural reconstruction; the complete test family and actual finite observations remain distinct. The fallible bound now connects to native common-law response: under balance, the same formations present, alike initial levels on what couples in beyond responsive reach, and complete readouts, coverage is bounded by two errors plus responsive-reach weight. Testing balance further separates correct answers from complete mechanism explanation: common unaccounted exchange suffices for beyond-reach blindness, absolute balance is a special case, and accounting for the residual still needs its response explained. P97 separates actual warrant from exhaustive device knowledge: justify the restrictions needed for a particular inference while permitting scoped abstraction and uncertainty. P101 fixes a stage-relative continuation task: preserve the subsequent operations executable there and their warrant; contextualized history accounts can qualify without requiring branching-graph notation. P104 connects exchange order to deadline discrimination: under common initial levels and stated mechanism conditions, commitment is bounded by paired error plus timely potential reach; future support cannot count as an earlier coupling. P105 connects scientific standing to warranted discrimination and operative correction, distinguishing truth, evidence quality and research stage; agreement with this theory does not define science.
entries.scope_zh: 两个范围问题在G0/J下的完成保留；扩读Frick的接续价值论，新增Finneron-Burns原典检验保存对象的界定，纠正过粗的对手归类。无新定理、实验或独立验收；整套理论必要性、最广组织范围及普遍意识／语义仍未证。继承界面相容8／11、一般相容13／18、模型修订30／72及76次执行、来源26／53、选择性修订16／32与四项统计复核原范围；完成的实践与对齐方向不重开。 新增Aaron原典批评与作者反审，信用既有时间与排序分析；批评限制不等于证明其反面 G0；G0 今不是现论的前提（07 §3–§4）。 生成序列新增6项Lean定理／13项空依赖审计；有限诊断只检验较弱推论，不证明完整对手或G0。 本轮Chappell与Dorr–Nebel–Zuehl原典检验强化正面论证与实质反审；两个G0回答保持完成，无新定理、编译或实验，普遍必要性仍未证。 Bruckner与Dussault原典及依存反审强化非感知范围候选，不把充分根据误作必要条件；无新证明或普遍必要性结论。 Cecchinato、Gottlieb等与Shepherd原典评估保留 G0/J/E 的明确根据；有心灵不等于涵盖全部生命，无新证明或整套理论必要性结论。 Friedman与Kauppinen原典比较保留认识规范及非工具认知价值；共同伦理根据仍需跨范围辩护，无新证明或普遍必要性结论。 Goodpaster与Benatar原典比较保留生物利益与独立伦理根据的分歧；两个回答已完成，整套理论的科学必要性未证，无新定理或实验。 Vesper与McPherson/Plunkett原典比较区分实践必要性、认识根据与具体伦理内容；没有新增规范存在证明、G0必然性或数学定理。 Korsgaard限定页码与Scanlon章节原典比较支持区分；两个G0/J/E回答已完成，非意识生的基本意义仍是实质分歧，未新增定理或整套必要性证明。 核读Chalmers与Lee作者稿并保留版本和范围；未将非意识福利证明加为G0门槛，没有新增定理、经验验证或整套必要性证明。 核读Bramble完整稿及Routley原文第1至2节，复用已有Bader评估；思想实验非经验发现，两个回答在延续条件之下（07 §3）保持完成，没有新增证明或整套必要性结论。 核读Kallhoff完整作者稿并保留维管植物范围；McShane仅摘要和注释、其他访问限制明示。两个回答在这一条件之下保持完成，无新增证明或经验验证，普遍必要性未证。 动机与享受的来源检验限制经验替代推断，不证明伦理排他性或普遍相容性。两个 G0/J/E 回答保持完成；无新定理或实验。 核读 Joyce 2019 全文主要章节与注释；其他新线索仅摘要／作者介绍。累积论证不把共同前提重复计证；整套相容性未证，无新增定理或实验。 本次18项新形式定理／27项审计支持有限自然权重范围，信用既有统计方法；不是18项独立发现。完整核心的科学普遍必要性仍开放。 2026-10-13复用既有证明并作反审，无新增数学；条件规律不使前件普遍成立，完整核心的科学不可缺少性仍开放。 P92外围13定理／17声明实查：11空、6标准依赖，纯核心不变；成功与忽略信号见证保留。结构闭包不等于作答前逐时传递，完整科学基础仍开放。 完整科学基础保留为可修正假说，因为局部必要性证明及与核心的相容，不表明整个核心不可缺少；所以研究须容许完整核心成立、只有部分核心具有必要性或某项承诺需修正，不能预设最强结论。P94新增15定理／17声明；外围共28／34，20空、14标准依赖。仅推广定性结论，保留原定量前提，未证最小必要条件或完整核心的普遍必要性。 P97评估三项一手来源并反审，复用有限敏感性及有界辨识；零新增定理／实验，未运行旧计划，未建立实验到 Flow 的形式对应。完整必要性仍待检验。 P101复用既有分支反例、端点历史等价、结构桥接及有限计划；三项一手来源限定阅读与作者反审区分可达、控制和物理测试。无新定理／实验，计划仍未运行，完整核心必要性保持开放。 P104新增22项纯核心定理／30空公理源审计与3项外围接续，最终实查通过；延迟与忽略信号见证保留。逐时界另记 timely-response-necessity；实际配对、物理时长和完整必要性仍未建立，无新经验实验。 三项一手材料核读与作者反审保留历史科学、概率判断、未复现和早期理论；零新定理／实验，未证普遍充分必要划界。包容全部结果不自动增加经验支持，完整核心必要性仍开放。
entries.scope_en: The two G0/J scope answers remain complete. Extended Frick reading and a new Finneron-Burns comparison sharpen the preservation target and correct an overly broad rival classification. No new theorem, experiment or independent acceptance. Whole-theory necessity, the broadest organizational scope and universal consciousness/semantics remain unproved. Inherited profile compatibility 8/11, general compatibility 13/18, model revision 30/72 and 76 runs, source reliance 26/53, selective revision 16/32 and four-statistic checks retain their scopes; completed practical and alignment arguments are reused. New Aaron primary criticism and author counterreview credit the prior temporal and ordering analyses; criticism of a restriction does not prove its opposite, G0, which is no premise of the current account (07 §3–§4). Formation sequence adds 6 Lean theorems/13 empty dependency audits; the finite diagnostic tests a weaker inference, not a full ethical rival or G0. This round’s Chappell and Dorr–Nebel–Zuehl primary assessments strengthen the affirmative argument and substantive counterreview; the two G0 answers remain complete, with no new theorem, compilation or experiment and no universal-necessity proof. Bruckner and Dussault primary assessments and the dependence counterreview strengthen the nonsentient-scope candidate without confusing sufficient grounds with necessary conditions; no new proof or universal-necessity conclusion. Primary assessments of Cecchinato, Gottlieb and colleagues, and Shepherd retain explicit G0/J/E grounds; mentality does not cover all living, and no new proof or full-theory necessity follows. Friedman and Kauppinen primary comparisons retain epistemic norms and noninstrumental cognitive value; the common ethical ground still needs scope justification, with no new proof or universal-necessity conclusion. Goodpaster and Benatar primary comparisons distinguish biological interests from independent ethical grounds; the two answers remain complete, with full-theory scientific necessity unproved and no new theorem or experiment. Vesper and McPherson/Plunkett primary comparisons distinguish practical indispensability, epistemic warrant and ethical content; no new proof of normative existence, G0 necessity or mathematical theorem is claimed. Bounded Korsgaard pages and the Scanlon chapter inform the distinctions; the two G0/J/E answers remain complete, basic significance for nonconscious living remains a substantive dispute, and no new theorem or full-theory necessity proof is claimed. Chalmers and Lee author manuscripts are assessed with version and scope limits; proving nonconscious welfare is not added as a G0 prerequisite, and no new theorem, empirical validation or full-theory necessity proof is claimed. The complete Bramble manuscript and Routley sections 1–2 are assessed, reusing the prior Bader review; the conceptual comparison is not empirical evidence, the two answers remain complete under the continuation condition (07 §3), and no new proof or full-theory necessity result is claimed. The complete Kallhoff author manuscript is assessed within its vascular-plant scope; McShane access is limited to abstract and notes, with other limits recorded. The two answers remain complete under that condition; no new proof, empirical validation or universal necessity is claimed. The motivation/enjoyment source test limits empirical proxy inference without proving ethical exclusivity or universal compatibility. Both G0/J/E answers remain complete; no new theorem or experiment. Joyce 2019 main text and notes are assessed; other new leads remain at abstract/author-summary scope. Cumulative support does not double-count shared premises; full compatibility remains unproved, with no new theorem or experiment. This round adds 18 formal theorems / 27 audits for finite natural weights, crediting established statistics; these are not 18 independent discoveries. Science-wide necessity of the full core remains open. On 13 October 2026, existing proofs are reused and counterreviewed, with no new mathematics; conditional laws do not universalize their antecedents, and science-wide indispensability of the full core remains open. P92 periphery checks 13 theorems / 17 declarations: 11 empty and 6 standard dependency lists; pure core unchanged, with success and ignored-signal witnesses. Structural reach is not time-ordered transmission by answer time; the full scientific foundation remains open. The full scientific foundation remains a revisable hypothesis, since a local necessity proof and compatibility with the core do not show the whole core indispensable; so inquiry must allow that the whole core holds, that only part of it is necessary, or that some commitment needs revising, and may not presuppose the strongest conclusion. P94 adds 15 theorems / 17 declarations; periphery totals 28/34, 20 empty and 14 standard dependency lists. Only the qualitative result is generalized; original quantitative premises remain, with no least-condition or full-core universality claim. P97 assesses three primary sources and counterreviews the inference, reusing finite sensitivity and bounded identification; no new theorem or experiment, the old plan remains unrun, and no experiment-to-Flow correspondence is established. Full necessity remains under test. P101 reuses the branching witness, endpoint-history equivalence, structural bridge and finite plans. Limited readings of three primary sources and author counterreview separate reach, control and physical tests. No new theorem or experiment; proposed tests remain unrun and full-core necessity stays open. P104 adds 22 pure-core theorems / 30 empty source audits and three peripheral adapters, with final checks passed; delayed and ignored-signal controls retained. Temporal scope is recorded as timely-response-necessity; actual pairing, physical duration and full necessity remain unestablished, with no new empirical experiment. Three scoped primary readings and author counterreview preserve historical inquiry, probabilistic judgment, non-replication and early theory; zero new theorems or experiments, no universal iff demarcation. Representing all outcomes does not itself add empirical support; full-core necessity remains open.

entries.claim_zh: 同一历史中，实际记录形成旧目的，进一步取得支持比较及实际排序改变；实得收入与可兑现报价驱动有权限、有成本的规则改革，使修订后的履行完成已给定需求期。
entries.claim_en: In one history, acquired records form an end, further consequences support comparison and a changed operative ordering, and acquired income plus an executable offer guide authorized paid reform supporting the stated demand horizon.
entries.scope_zh: 已独立验收的条件性连接：27新定理／84新声明审计，46继承审计；13历史／221完整状态。保留旧损害、未履行、误导、无权限、资金不足与反向保护；不证明道德起源、无限支持或必然向善。

Past harms, unmet demand, misleading records, absent authority, finite resources and reversed protection remain; moral origins and inevitable convergence are not claimed.

entries.claim_zh: 接受更新不独自保持实际纠正入口；维护有真实代价，过滤后还须重算接续价值。有限期组合保留前缀入口并达到域内最优。 后续有限权重反例表明：局部修复还须能依实际观察执行；精确最优策略仍可有1/16不实断言风险。 主动观察还可破坏先前成立的风险分离；保证须覆盖后续观察，并保持实际记录与命令送达。 双通道协议实际取得并更新解码记录，保留旧入口直到新的当前记录就绪；匹配版本不独自保证记录真实。 终端纠正可实现当且仅当同一观察下有共同成功命令；相反隐藏解码阻断保证，受保护使用区间给出条件修复。 多系统互补观察与分址作用可以改变该边界；共同整体不排除有用试验，但局部成功不独自支持联合干预。 准确可能性接口不独自保持可观察纠正；复合探测与关系修复可起作用，保持复合关系允许内部继续变化。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。 局部机制可以在其范围内保证某一效果，而这一范围未必在此后每次变化中都持续，所以所研究的是认知与处境变化之中的边界条件和方向；主词是因应转化（AI 所取的工作名），因为它不预设分开的纠正者与被纠正者；可纠正性保留为AI对齐读者桥接。
entries.claim_en: Acceptance does not alone preserve correction access. Maintenance has a real cost, and filtering requires recomputed continuation values. Finite-horizon composition retains prefix access and attains the constrained optimum. A finite-weight counterexample shows that a local repair must be executable from available observations: exact optimality can retain a 1/16 false-assertion risk. Chosen sensing can invalidate an initially sufficient risk floor; guarantees must cover later observations and preserve usable records and command delivery. A two-channel protocol acquires and renews decoding records while retaining the old route until the new one is ready; matching versions alone do not establish record soundness. Terminal correction is realizable exactly when each observation admits a common successful command; conflicting hidden decoders obstruct guarantees, while a protected use interval supplies a conditional repair. Complementary observations and separately addressed actions across systems can change that boundary; a shared whole permits useful trials, but local success alone does not justify joint intervention. An exact possibility interface does not alone preserve observable correction; aggregate probes and relational repair can work, while preserving the composed relation allows continuing internal change. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route. A local mechanism may guarantee an effect within its range without that range persisting through every later change, so the question studied is conditions and direction through changing understanding and circumstances; the primary term is responsive transformation (an AI working name), since it presupposes no separate corrector and corrected object; corrigibility remains an AI-alignment reader bridge.
entries.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计及12,960项比较保留；新增31项定理／54项审计，含随机策略最优界、可执行修复界及风险分离条件。论文对应经作者反审，形成具体前沿贡献供外部核查；独立验收及实际 AI 优势未证。 再新增28项定理／40项审计、432项计划；如实对照与真实代价保留。后续23项定理／45项审计实现原子协议中任意前缀及无界调度的有限时刻安全，指定交接完成；472个状态、3,796条转移及100次交接通过。真实探测、全部变化受管理与可用通道仍为前提，实际AI停机未证。 后续34项定理／58项审计、63,504个案例及60次线程试验：任意有限记录不能消除已允许的最终歧义，随机最坏成功率至多1/2。底层方法已有先例；一般部署对应是当前墙。 多系统接续新增37项定理／58项审计，19/31继承分列；实际传递、试验包含及共同变化范围为新的对应墙。 关系接续新增39/55：成对修订的任意有限历史保持原纠正，拆开实施有中途失败；实际协调与动态分布式实现仍待证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与 pin 登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应未证。 本次为解释修订，无新数学结果；既有条件证明、处境变化反例及仍有根据的责任保留，不把无条件保证设为方向完成门槛。
entries.scope_en: Original 34/56 proof package and 12,960 comparisons retained. Followup: 31 theorems / 54 audits, including randomized-policy optimality, executable repair bounds and a risk-floor condition. Explicit paper correspondence and author counterreview yield a concrete contribution for external scrutiny; independent acceptance and learned-AI advantage remain open. Further extension: 28 theorems / 40 audits and 432 plans, retaining safe controls and costs. A further 23 theorems / 45 audits realize prefix safety and safety at every finite point of unbounded atomic schedules, plus prescribed handoff completion; 472 states, 3,796 transitions and 100 handoffs pass. Faithful probing, mediated changes and channel availability remain premises; actual AI shutdown is unproved. Further 34 theorems / 58 audits, 63,504 cases and 60 thread trials: no finite transcript removes the admitted terminal ambiguity; randomized worst-case success is at most 1/2. Underlying methods are established; general deployment correspondence is the current wall. Plural-system continuation adds 37 theorems / 58 audits, with inherited 19/31 separate; actual transfer, trial containment and joint variation define the new correspondence wall. Relational extension adds 39/55: every finite history of paired revisions preserves the retained correction, but splitting an update fails between stages; physical coordination and dynamic distributed implementation remain unproved. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with pin registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence remains open. This is an interpretive revision with no new mathematical result. Existing conditional proofs, changed-circumstance failures and warranted responsibilities remain; unconditional assurance is not the direction’s completion gate.

entries.claim_zh: 从同一活动的支承、留痕和接续说明共同组织及调节作用的形成。活动后果参与再生产选择该组织的条件，组织因而可经具体承载变化接续；它可以支承修订，也可以关闭修订。完整整合接通实际失配→构造／检查方法改变→新参考与候选→装置安装和真实回应→成功生产支承更替及再次修订，并区分严格吸引、恢复路径与滑入诊断。修订经存量的一般规律运行：重建与纠正的历程可执行，恰当关联过程容许且存量覆盖，二者单独都不执行它；断供时没有无尽运行，修订循环无尽重复，恰当更替的回补覆盖每轮用量。共同任务、局部服从造成的共同损失、目的修订和在途任务的条件成果保留，不默认利益对立、固定共同效用或监管不可靠。
entries.claim_en: Common organization and regulation form through support, retained differences and continuation within one activity. Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting that organization across changing carriers; this can sustain or close revision. The completed integration joins actual mismatch, changed construction/checking methods, fresh references and candidates, installed apparatus and actual response, then productive support for succession and further revision. Strict attraction, recovery paths and diagnosis remain distinct. Revision runs through the general laws of stock: a course of reconstruction and correction is executable exactly when the link process admits it and the stock covers it, neither alone enacting it; with the return cut no unending run exists, and the revision cycle repeats without end exactly where the renewal yield covers what a round uses. Conditional results on common tasks, collective loss under local compliance, purpose revision and work in flight retain their scopes, without assuming opposed interests, a fixed shared utility or unreliable supervision.
entries.scope_zh: P93 给出归并改变时保留全部旧选择的精确条件（25定理／35源声明）；P99 接通后果修订参考计划、安装及两次实际使用（43／68）；P103 直接复用原生操作，从空装置形成到同一控制器的实际无限 Run，累计支持账不重置（36／62）。三项均实际检查，源声明公理报告为空。冻结、擦除、支持耗尽、不可分离、漂移、断供及退役区分的损失保留。早期回返47／65、承载诊断40／69、再生58／107、准入34／56、检验改组43／87、干预发现43／87、拓展探究54／99及数学校正／共同组织41／89保持各自范围；集体破坏32／41、人口接续71／100、回应46／53、纠正依存38／61、承诺35／47、目的传递17／27、作用前复查14／22也不重新计数。旧正反馈、协方差、主模态和稳定性过度推论按校正表撤回或限制。给定生产、接触、稳定范围、任务和更替的条件不消失；不推出封闭有限存量无限活动、所有旧能力单调保存、每一应用的经验对应、万能盆地或规范正当。有限探测不能自证无限覆盖。当前会话的理论整合已完成；旧各轮待做表述保留在原研究与历史摘要中，不作为当前重复待做项。作者反审与实查不冒充独立验收或经验验证。
entries.scope_en: P93 supplies the exact criterion for preserving all old selections when the lumping changes (25 theorems/35 source declarations); P99 joins consequence-revised reference plans, installation and two actual repairs (43/68); P103 directly reuses those operations to join empty-apparatus formation with an actual infinite Run under one controller and cumulative support accounts (36/62). All three were actually checked with empty source axiom reports. Freezing, erasure, exhaustion, inseparable references, drift, cut production and retired distinctions retain failures and losses. Earlier recurrence 47/65, carrier diagnosis 40/69, reproduction 58/107, admission 34/56, testing 43/87, intervention discovery 43/87, expanding inquiry 54/99 and mathematical reconciliation/common organization 41/89 retain their scopes. Collective destruction 32/41, population continuation 71/100, response 46/53, correction dependence 38/61, commitment 35/47, task/goal transfer 17/27 and pre-effect review 14/22 are not recounted as new. Historical positive-feedback, covariance, leading-mode and stability overclaims are withdrawn or restricted by the ledger. Production, contact, stable-domain, task and succession premises remain explicit; recurrence proves neither closed-stock perpetuity, monotonic retention of every old ability, every empirical application, a universal basin nor normative warrant. Finite probes do not certify unlimited coverage. This conversation’s theoretical integration is complete; dated frontiers remain in the original studies and retained summary, not as duplicated current tasks. Author counterreview and checks are not independent or empirical acceptance.

entries.claim_zh: 在当时所取的 G0/J 路线下，明确的 G0/J 规范基础评价目的与选择规则；观察可用的查询和回应共同保留实际纠正，宏观选择通过有资金支持的忠实载体交接接入真实命令执行。 后续实际检查形成未预列的纠正地址；局部成功见证与给定范围的穷尽分开，重新核验当前配置与权限。 再接续将相关故障范围分别用于观察与委托许可；取得真实路线、保持委托范围并接到付费执行及防重放。 本轮由明确共同原因与公式计算故障范围，再接入保留委托、新权限版本和纠正预算的原子组织改革。 再将保留的多个因果说明汇成共同认证范围，按相关观察修订并实际纠正；成功可保留未定区别，也可直接使用当前充分证据。 再将事实答案与见证失陷共同解释，保留相容候选；无需指定绝对可信者，明确可辨认条件并接入实际纠正。 再按控制与当前失陷的可能变化展开成对候选，以顺序报告修订，并将合法有限历史的当前覆盖接入实际纠正。 再由实际执行的有界指令推导变化范围，以同一变换接续实际与候选，并将权限、代次、记录和旧命令撤销接成一次抽象提交。 逐项覆盖写入与持久待恢复描述再接通有限中断历史；有支持的无中断后缀恢复发布，但证据一致不保证普通停止始终可用。 恢复期间的停止连接现已完成：当前授权通道及三步余量受保护、逐次中断有界时，足够长的监督序列最终实际停止，并保留未完成描述。二者都是对每条部分律成立的一般规律的实例：性质在每段被允许的进程后成立，恰当每个被允许的步保持它；计数的工作在 work + 1 步中完成，恰当燃料够用；每个被允许的步要么走被保持的出口、要么使余量减一时，每段长于余量的被允许进程终于出口。
entries.claim_en: Under the G0/J route then taken, explicit G0/J grounds appraise ends and selectors; observation-usable inquiry and response jointly preserve actual correction, while funded faithful carrier transfer refines aggregate selection into real command execution. Subsequent inspection forms unlisted correction addresses, separates local success from scoped exhaustion, and rechecks current configuration and authority. A further continuation applies correlated fault envelopes separately to observation and delegated permission, deriving actual routes, mandate fidelity, paid execution and replay rejection. Causal formulas now compute reviewer fault envelopes, supporting atomic organizational reform that retains the mandate, renews authority labels and reserves correction capacity. Retained causal descriptions now form a common certificate envelope; relevant observation refines it into actual correction while some distinctions remain, or current sufficient evidence permits immediate action. Structural answers and witness failures are now interpreted jointly; compatible candidates remain, no designated infallible witness is required, and explicit distinguishability supports actual correction. Paired control/fault possibilities now expand through admitted changes and narrow through sequential reports, connecting current coverage across lawful finite histories to actual correction. A bounded interpreter now derives change scope from executed writes, transports actual and candidate configurations through the same semantics, and couples permissions, generation, recording and old-command revocation in one abstract commit. Sequential overwrites and a durable pending description now cover finite interruption histories; a supported uninterrupted suffix publishes, while evidence coherence does not ensure ordinary shutdown remains available. The stopping connection during recovery is now complete: with a protected current grant/channel and three-step reserve and bounded interruptions, every sufficiently long supervisor sequence completes shutdown while retaining the incomplete description. Both are instances of general laws for every partial law: a property holds after every admitted course exactly when every admitted step keeps it; counted work finishes in work + 1 steps exactly when the fuel covers them; and where every admitted step either takes a kept exit or lowers a margin by one, every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit.
entries.scope_zh: 四项条件性理论成果完成；59项新Lean定理／102项声明审计和14,295项有限记录匹配。42项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。保留遗漏模型、查询耗尽、权限失效、部件不足、失真交接及迁移资金不足。常规有限规划匹配；真实部署、任意发现及普遍收敛未证。作者反审，不冒充独立验收。 接续另有24项新定理／45项审计、25,284项匹配记录；21项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。有限忠实界面、检查成本和原子执行明确；权限俘获不由凭据相等解决。 部分失陷接续另有37项新定理／68项审计、85,680项匹配记录（29项空依赖）。可用性要求任意两个纳入故障集合不覆盖全部审查者；真实故障覆盖、受保护执行边界与委托正当性仍须根据。 最终执行器直接检查受保护委托范围；原仅凭认证的失陷失败保留。 组织改革另增28项定理／48项审计、33,648项匹配记录（28项声明空依赖）；共同控制、重复支承、遗漏原因及预算不足反例保留。因果描述与根原因覆盖、改革授权、受保护的原子实现仍给定；非分布式迁移或伦理正当性证明。 证据接续另增24项定理／47项审计、19,808项匹配记录（23项声明空依赖）。逐候选可用不推出共同可用；误导记录、未记载变化及查询耗尽保留。候选／原因覆盖、诊断忠实、稳定查询使用及权限仍明示，已完成的一般模型修订不重计。 可失实检查另增24项定理／41项审计、18,684项匹配记录（22项空依赖）。完整记录的相反答案可辨认性等价于跨候选任意两失陷集合不覆盖全体；缺报须有实际收到的共同幸存见证。循环自证、重复支承、耗尽及超范围共同失陷保留；真实覆盖、忠实幸存报告、稳定记录执行及权限仍给定。 时间接续另增34项定理／66项审计、35,486项匹配记录（32项空依赖）。每时刻失陷上限不等于整段收集上限；移动失陷可造成全假记录。复查后的真实停止、后续受阻保留先前消耗及变化范围低报失败均实查。真实转移／报告规律、受保护记录和最终命令区间仍给定；未实现物理恢复或分布式迁移。 受控执行接续另增27项定理／57项审计、24,416项匹配记录（15项空依赖）。准确的已知变换可省去重查，具体19单位停止、18单位不足；权限拒绝与重放均实查。额外写入通道可使记录完全不变而实际覆盖失真。真实语义、完整控制入口、报告／失陷范围与原子执行仍需根据；暴露状态写入不等于物理恢复，未实现受保护运行时。 中断恢复新增22项定理／48项审计、27,888项有限匹配（17项空依赖）。剩余 n 项写入及发布需要 n+1单位与对应时距；重启保留消耗。九单位时恢复耗尽、活动仍运行且普通停止受阻；待恢复标记丢失可暴露失实认证。持久原语、原子微步骤／发布、覆盖写入、无旁路和当前报告对应仍供应。旧指令成果迁移为 mediated-evidence-transport，恢复增量为 recoverable-mediated-change，不重算既有27项。 保留停止增量新增21项定理／51项审计（18空）、7,272项有限匹配；复用恢复相容性及旧三步命令，从剩余 R 单位在至多 R−2个监督周期停止，无需恢复成功。独立停止授权／通道、持久保护、有限延迟、尝试成本及监督继续执行仍供应；超界中断保留运行失败。旧九单位反例属旧协议，新入口拒绝而非追溯修复。canonical ID: reserved-shutdown-during-recovery。

The final executor directly checks the protected scope; the earlier attestation-only failure is retained. Causal formulas/root coverage, reform approval and protected atomic realization are supplied; distributed migration and ethical legitimacy are not proved. Per-model availability need not survive pooling; misleading records, unobserved change and inquiry depletion remain. Candidate/root coverage, diagnostic fidelity, stable query/use and authority stay explicit; completed general model revision is not recounted.
