Opposite-answer complete-transcript diagnosability is equivalent to cross-candidate pairwise fault noncoverage; partial transcripts require received common-survivor evidence. Self-certification, duplicate support, exhaustion and uncovered joint faults remain; actual coverage, faithful surviving reports, stable recording/execution and authority remain supplied. Temporal continuation adds 34 theorems / 66 audits and 35,486 matched records (32 empty dependencies). Instantaneous fault bounds do not bound the collection window; moving corruption can produce all-false reports. Reinspection-to-shutdown, preservation of spent prefixes and understated-transition failure are checked. Actual transition/report laws, protected recording and the final command interval remain supplied; physical recovery and distributed migration are not implemented. Mediated-control continuation adds 27 theorems / 57 audits and 24,416 matched records (15 empty dependencies). Exact known transforms can avoid reinspection; the worked shutdown costs 19 units and fails with 18. Denied rights and replay are checked. An extra writer can preserve all public records while breaking actual coverage. Physical semantics, complete mediation, report/fault coverage and atomic execution remain conditions; the exposure setter is not physical recovery and no protected runtime is implemented. Interrupted recovery adds 22 theorems / 48 audits and 27,888 finite matches (17 empty dependencies). Remaining n writes plus publication require n+1 units and corresponding time; restart retains consumption. At nine units, recovery exhausts while activity keeps running and ordinary shutdown is blocked; losing the pending marker can expose a false certificate. Durable primitives, atomic microsteps/publication, overwrite semantics, no bypass and current reports remain supplied. The previous instruction result is migrated as mediated-evidence-transport; the delta is recoverable-mediated-change, without recounting the prior 27. It reuses recovery coherence and the existing three-step command, stopping within R−2 supervisor cycles from R remaining units without recovery success. Independent stop authority/channel, durable protection, bounded delay, attempt cost and continued scheduling remain supplied; excessive interruption retains a running failure. The old nine-unit failure remains for the old protocol; new admission refuses it rather than repairing it retroactively. Canonical ID: reserved-shutdown-during-recovery.

entries.title_zh: 认知发展与取得的组合解释
entries.title_en: Cognitive development and acquired compositional interpretation
entries.claim_zh: 取得的组合操作进入沟通、分节、绑定及新使用；行动与访问记录改变后续经历。后得来源关系重释旧命名，日期化证据进一步约束其历史适用范围。经验覆盖与保留边界、错误确信及暂时变化失败保留，完整认知目标未完成。 发育与比较证据进一步区分访问关系的取得、保持及任务中的实际使用。 后果现将学习所得接入更新组织的重构：零矩阵的实际取得、后续表现、记录及更新控制的传递与后继使用接成同一段历史。在所述构造中，这对每次接触之后的忠实重构都成立：它传递网络与更新控制位，按容量建成后继，并保持材料与支持。整体表现可影响组成关系的接续；一般连接在条件范围内完成。 绑定结果现已成为对每类记录与历史成立的律：分组恢复每个编码序列的词，当且仅当每个词内部相连，且任何词的末元素都不连到任何词的首元素；意义可判定地比较时，形式在不重复的候选范围中解析为某意义，恰当每个关涉该形式的记录都提供它，且其他每个意义都缺于某个关涉的记录，后来的记录只缩小候选；报告与内容可判定地比较时，日期化记录在一族历史中确定旧记录的内容，恰当每个以另一内容给出同一记录的族内对手都被某一日期化控制区分。行动场景与合作命名是第二条律的实例，回溯重读是它经一族解释读记录的形式的实例，四时刻来源史是第三条律的实例；其失败（在一处命名、错时命名、后来的路线改变、遗漏的暂时变化）落在律不成立的一侧。 观察在下游之内：对每个读入每个条件一个所列水平之时程的律，同样形成在场、部分动作相同、其余遵从律而起始只在一个储量上不同的两个平衡进程，在每一步、在按到那一步形成的所读路线不在储量下游的每个条件上都相同（`apart_only_downstream`）；所以一个形成的交换只经它所读、位于储量下游的水平回应储量之差（`exchange_alike_off_downstream`），直接观察是长度为零的路线。运行分开之处，前段与律都不固定其去向：两个运行在一步分开，指它们经映射的历程在此步之前相同、在此步不同；此前的前段是同一个，所以没有外推，无论被给予什么（律在内），在两个运行上都对（`Parting.not_right_on_both`）；移动与配置列出、步已定时，依过程所建之外推在一步于每个运行上都对，恰当那一步没有两个运行分开（`Parting.world_right_iff`）。从一个配置出发没有两个运行分开、值已定、运行被 N 个配置的列表所持时，按最小界的外推不被给予什么，从 2N − 1 起都对（`Parting.leastBound_right`），同于确定的律，后者处处不分开（`Parting.unparted_of_determined`）。
entries.claim_en: Acquired composition enters communication, grouping, binding and new use; activity and access records change later encounters. Later source learning reinterprets old naming, and dated evidence constrains its historical applicability. Empirical coverage/retention limits, mistaken confidence and temporary-change failure remain; the full cognitive goal is incomplete. Developmental and comparative evidence further distinguishes formation, retention and task-specific use of access relations. Consequences now connect learned use to reconstruction of the updating organization: actual zero-matrix acquisition, subsequent performance, copied record/procedure and successor use form one connected history. In the declared construction this holds of every exposure followed by a faithful reconstruction: it passes on the network and procedure bit, builds as many successors as capacity allows and conserves material and support. Whole performance can affect constituent continuation; the general connection is completed at its conditional scope. The binding results now hold as laws for every type of records and histories: grouping recovers the words of every encoded sequence exactly when each word is linked inside and no word's last element is linked to any word's first; with meanings compared decidedly, a form resolves to a meaning in a repertoire without repeats exactly when every record bearing on the form offers it and every other meaning is missing from some bearing record, further records only narrowing its candidates; and, with reports and contents compared decidedly, dated records settle an earlier record's content within a family of histories exactly when every rival giving the same record with another content is told apart by some dated control. Enacted scenes and cooperative naming are instances of the second law, retrospective rereading of its form for records read through a family of explanations, and the four-moment source histories of the third; their failures (naming from one place, mistimed naming, a later route change, an omitted temporary change) lie on the laws' failing side. Observing lies within the downstream: under every law reading into each condition a schedule of listed levels, two balanced courses with the same formations present, the part acting alike and the rest following the law, apart at the start only in a stock, stand alike at each step at every condition not downstream of the stock by the readings formed by then (`apart_only_downstream`). So a formation's exchange responds to the stock's difference only through a level it reads that lies downstream of the stock (`exchange_alike_off_downstream`), direct observation being the route of length zero. Where runs part, neither the prefix nor the law fixes the way: two runs part at a step where their courses through the map are alike before it and differ at it; the prefixes before it are one, so no extrapolation, whatever it is given, the law included, is right on both (`Parting.not_right_on_both`). With moves and configurations listed and steps decided, the extrapolation built from the process is right at a step on every run exactly where no two runs part there (`Parting.world_right_iff`). Where no two runs from a configuration part, with the values decided and the run held by a list of N configurations, the extrapolation by the least bound, given nothing, is right from 2N − 1 on (`Parting.leastBound_right`), as for determined laws, which part nowhere (`Parting.unparted_of_determined`).
entries.scope_zh: 取得25项定理／52项审计；构造37／65；传递27／45；分节23／51；绑定23／41；行动场景16／29；经历选择22／46；回溯绑定20／36；历史绑定10／36（最新304项继承定理／549项审计分列）。空间、类别、目录、准则、初次巡查与合作命名仍有给定；历史组合要求身份、时序、校准和变化／扰动范围，不提供新的资源耗用律；四时刻历史是对每类历史成立之律的实例。经验：36人1,508次命名，三秒467次其他注视而零所指，另45次两者零，五秒前类393次；75人451试次主动−配对−1.34个百分点，95%区间[−10.38,+7.69]不证等效。五篇原典约束自动迁移，未新复算：下一重点是在匹配程序中区分访问取得、来源／次序保持与实际使用，分别测当前依赖及旧内容认可。任务差异的原因、心理实现、演化及意识未完成。 新增学习方式传递30项定理／50项审计，独立重建157项继承定理／251项审计。精确实数复制、两种方式、任务回报转换、有限供给及构造明示给定，校准重新取得；转化、擦除和材料限制保留失败。相对增殖及局部成功不定义生成性，不证明无条件长程对齐或全部认知完成。 观察（`Becoming.Observation`，记录 observation-is-a-route）：无公理，不判定条件，也不需条件有限；律所读的时程是给定的；在下游者是否不同、带误差的量度、律读哪个时程都不推出。读法减弱为 `apart_only_downstream` 所表明的，因为观察不是依赖之外的第二种关系这一说法超出该定理（D43）；观察能否由依赖推出，已在交换之步解决：条件的相等可判定、活动需要支持时，单凭依赖恰好带出随某水平上升至一界的回应，有总量固定的补时带出每个回应，所以观察只对没有补的下降回应才真是第二种关系（what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level）；在二者都是耦合、观察依水平而依赖依阈值的意义上，它不是第二种关系，这是 D45 采用的读法（where-a-level-couples）；二者都不在这一环节之内。分开（`Becoming.Parting`，记录 identification-where-runs-part）：无公理；逆命题需要列出的移动与配置、已定的步与已定的值；运行分开之处，配置之界不界定任何历程（`Parting.free_unbounded`）；无穷或不可判定的过程中依过程所建之外推不推出。两个环节不加前提，不改定理（D43）；它们在本条目中的位置是 AI 的提议，未给论证。
entries.scope_en: Acquisition 25 theorems/52 audits; formation 37/65; transmission 27/45; grouping 23/51; binding 23/41; enacted scenes 16/29; encounter selection 22/46; retrospective binding 20/36; historical binding 10/36 (latest 304 inherited theorems/549 audits separate). Spatial/category laws, catalogue, criterion, initial surveys and cooperative naming retain supplied premises; historical composition requires identity, chronology, calibration and change/disturbance envelopes, with no new law of resource use; the four-moment histories are instances of a law for every type of histories. Empirical: 36 infants/1,508 events, 467 three-second other-without-target gaze cases plus 45 zero on both; 393 former cases at five seconds. For 75 participants/451 trials, Curiosity−Yoked −1.34 percentage points, 95% interval [−10.38,+7.69], not equivalence. Five primary papers constrain automatic transfer, without new reanalysis. Next distinguish access acquisition, source/order retention and actual use in a matched procedure, measuring present reliance and old-content endorsement separately. Causes of task differences, psychological realization, evolution and consciousness remain incomplete. Adds 30 new theorems / 50 audits for procedure transmission, independently rebuilt with 157 inherited theorems / 251 audits. Exact-real copying, two procedures, task-return conversion, finite supply and construction remain supplied; calibration is reacquired. Conversion/erasure and limited material preserve failures. Neither relative-frequency increase nor local task success defines generativity; no unconditional long-run alignment or full cognition completion. Observation (`Becoming.Observation`, record observation-is-a-route): no axiom, no decision on conditions and no finiteness of conditions; the schedule a law reads is given; that what lies downstream differs, measurement with error and which schedule a law reads are not shown. The reading is weakened to what `apart_only_downstream` shows, since the claim that observation is no second relation beside dependence goes beyond the theorem (D43); whether observation could be derived from dependence is settled at the step of the exchange: with equality of conditions decided and activity needing support, dependence alone carries of a level exactly the responses rising with it up to a bound, and with a complement at a fixed total every response, so observation is genuinely second only for a falling response with no complement (what-dependence-alone-carries-of-a-level); in the sense that both are coupling, observation by level and dependence by threshold, it is no second relation, a reading adopted in D45 (where-a-level-couples); neither is part of this link. Parting (`Becoming.Parting`, record identification-where-runs-part): no axiom; the converse needs listed moves and configurations, decided steps and decided values; where runs part, a bound on configurations bounds no course (`Parting.free_unbounded`), and the extrapolation built from the process is not shown for infinite or undecided processes. Both links add no premise and change no theorem (D43); their place in this entry is an AI proposal, with no argument given.

entries.title_zh: 过程核心、谓词与路径组合
entries.title_en: Process core predication and composition
entries.claim_zh: 给定变化关系后，有限历史通过实际共同中间配置组合；谓词可陈述保持性、可能性及全称终点性质，忠实抽象有明确局部条件。 生成逻辑首轮在左单位与原生上下文相容条件下，证明资源演算的收缩可容许当且仅当实际复制可达；有限供给有精确付费替代界限。 新的有限逐前缀继续谓词接入同一核心：每个请求步骤可继续，全部完成终点满足目标；有相反回应与成功后须调整的机制见证。 第二轮从原生占用规律推出局部历史允许的固定上下文精确判据；单相关支承位摘要保留所选工作负载的执行与整体事件步数预算。 第三轮证明：当前接入相同，允许改接范围内占用一致，当且仅当全部允许有限历史可行性一致。 第四轮将有来源保证的记录与逐位置核对接到同一原生取得过程；任意有限执行投影合法，并保留取得／使用预算。 无预设元逻辑续研提出同一规则的构成性根据候选：同一根据在同一认可要求下直接承接；完整奠基仍待完成。 接续区分由引入／使用构成的共同指向与经验再辨认；给定有限语法中，无来源、无周围假设的原子型 A → A 项必定返回所给根据。 固定规律下的返回判据现刻画实际历史中全部端点可能性的保留；无返回具有构造性的丧失端点见证，不完整问题可遮蔽它。 代入接续构造嵌套绑定中的替换：全部消费者求值保真，当且仅当各替换项供给原位置的根据；单假设代入及先后组合由此接通。 构成性评估现区分引用的设立、执行、辨认与根据：局部承接无需逐次新增认可命题，但不因此获得全部元推理资源的无前提正当性。
entries.claim_en: Given a transition relation, finite histories compose through a shared reached configuration; predicates express invariance, possibility and universal endpoint properties, with explicit local conditions for faithful abstraction. A logic pilot proves contraction admissible in a resource calculus exactly when duplication is reachable, under a left unit and primitive context compatibility; finite provision has a sharp paid-replacement bound. A finite prefix-sensitive obligation extends the same core: every requested step can continue and all completed endpoints meet the target, with mechanisms for opposite responses and adjustment after success. A continuation derives the exact frozen-context criterion from native occupancy laws; a relevant-slot summary preserves selected execution and merged-state event-count budgets. A third round proves that, at equal current routes, agreement on permitted-slot occupancy is equivalent to agreement on every allowed finite-word feasibility judgment. A fourth round connects maintained records and per-slot validation to the same native acquisition process, proving finite-trace projection and separate acquisition/use accounting. Direct metalogical inquiry adds a constitutive identity-rule candidate: re-presenting the same ground under the same assessment requirement; full grounding remains unfinished. A continuation distinguishes constituted binding from independent reidentification: every closed source-free atomic endomorphism in the supplied finite language returns its argument. A fixed-law return criterion now characterizes preservation of all endpoint possibilities along an actual history; absent return has a constructive lost endpoint witness, and incomplete questions can hide it. Constructed substitution under nested binders preserves evaluation for every consumer exactly when each replacement supplies its original position ground; single insertion and successive composition are connected. The constitutive assessment now distinguishes institution, execution, recognition and warrant: local retention needs no fresh endorsement proposition per use, but does not thereby justify every metainferential resource without presuppositions.
entries.scope_zh: 逻辑、配置／事件域及变化关系明确给定，未由此导出全部规律或伦理方向。完整说明附六模块61项空依赖审计，其中核心18项、新教学定理12项；可能性、无执行时的空真与实际进展分别保留。旧回执仍可查。 新38项定理／65项总审计（51空），含顺序复用不保证重叠、上下文干扰与完整补给包不可复制的反例。形成的是即时就绪；任意有限准备已计入可达性。未导出元逻辑；第一轮提出的上下文与摘要目标已由本次有范围结果接续。 新11项定理继承39项审计；50项中44空、6仅标准依赖。终点正确可遗漏中断；实际调度、物理时间与目标伦理根据另列。 新37项定理／220项闭包审计（124空）；新证明无经典选择。初始完整相容性、局部历史与固定占用条件明示；总量摘要失败，单支承摘要不能认证遗漏位置的相容性。整体预算不等于保持其他占用的准备，步数不等于真实时间。Iris/Leaf已有先例，仍属完成的整合而非新颖性证明。 新24项定理／42项总审计（30空）；原生三步历史产生旧工作负载等价、扩展范围可区分的配置。旧摘要加目的地不足以总能更新摘要。允许范围、原子性和身份给定；不禁止无损编码，未解决新读数取得。已完成交错研究直接复用。 新28项定理／70项闭包审计（38空）；新证明8空、20仅标准依赖，无经典选择。无关改变可继续；指定n次失效后读取／使用需n+2单位，任意有限预算有耗尽见证。原子可信读取、全部写入版本维护及原子核对／使用给定；此局部连接已完成，现实对应未证。 新11项形式审计均为空命名公理报告，仍使用 Lean 元理论。混合认可标准可不反身，反身性不独自保证接续；Curry 型固定点控制限制任意自我担保。实查不代替内容／根据辨认的哲学说明，既有无前提不可能性未证，亦未宣称完成或新逻辑。 新7项定理／21项含继承声明审计均空；继承14项不重计为新。关系保持由语法归纳得到；额外上下文或来源各有替代输入的见证。use解释、语法及元理论仍给定，实际绑定与假设代入的最终根据未证；非全体复合类型或任意程序的唯一性，不宣称新颖性。 新10项 Lean 定理／14项空审计，另重编23项继承定理／28项审计。身份、规律及端点含义给定；返回不抹去历史，未证明物理不可逆、伦理排序或零实质公理完成。仅作者反审。 再增9项定理／19项含继承审计，13空、6仅Quot.sound；同类型误接可改答案，同值可掩盖误接。有限语法、绑定解释、假设保证及实际输入满足公开；求值同一不独自给出完整意义／来源同一，无前提元逻辑仍未完成。 本次完成的是既有候选的哲学评估，零新增定理、未重编；先前笼统的绑定最终根据问题由具体的元推理推广不足取代。三条推广路线与实质对手已评估；严格目标未完成，也未证明不可能。
entries.scope_en: Logic, configuration/event domains and dynamics remain explicit inputs; this does not derive every law or ethical direction. The exposition checks six modules with 61 empty dependency audits, including 18 core audits and 12 new pedagogical theorems; possibility, vacuity and actual progress remain distinct. The earlier receipt is retained. New pilot: 38 theorems / 65 total audits (51 empty), retaining serial/overlap, contextual interference and funded-package duplication boundaries. Immediate readiness forms; unrestricted reachability already includes preparation. Metalogic is not established; the first-round context/abstraction target is continued by the scoped results below. Eleven new theorems plus 39 inherited audits; 44 of 50 reports empty, six standard only. Correct endpoints can omit interruption; scheduling, physical time and ethical target warrant remain separate. Continuation: 37 new theorems / 220 closure audits (124 empty), no new choice dependency. Full initial compatibility, a valid local history and a frozen frame are explicit. Counts lose readiness; the selected summary loses hidden-slot compatibility. Merged-state budgets do not imply preparation preserving held occupancy, and steps are not physical time. Iris/Leaf precedents remain credited; the scoped integration is complete, without a novelty claim. Reconfiguration: 24 new theorems / 42 total audits (30 empty). A native three-event history witnesses old-workload equivalence and separation under wider access; old active-view plus destination cannot always determine the new view. Permission scope, identities and atomicity remain supplied. Lossless encodings remain possible; observation acquisition is not established. Completed interleaving work is reused. Acquired-use continuation: 28 new theorems / 70 closure audits (38 empty); new reports are 8 empty and 20 standard only, with no choice. Unrelated change is allowed; n specified invalidation cycles then read/use cost n+2 units, and every finite budget has an exhaustion witness. Coherent atomic reads, full writer revision maintenance and atomic validate/use remain supplied. This local bridge is complete; realization is not established. Eleven new formal audits have empty named-axiom reports but retain Lean's metatheory. Mixed standards can fail reflexivity; reflexivity alone does not ensure composition. A Curry fixed-point control limits unrestricted self-certification. Formal checks do not establish philosophical recognition of content/ground; neither impossibility, completed presuppositionless grounding nor a new logic is claimed. Seven new theorems / 21 total declaration audits are empty, including 14 inherited audits. Relation preservation follows by syntax induction; ambient and introduced grounds give controls. Context-use interpretation, syntax and metatheory remain supplied; actual binding and hypothetical-substitution warrant remain open. The uniqueness scope is atomic terms, not all compound types or arbitrary programs; no novelty claim. Ten new Lean theorems / 14 empty audits; 23 inherited theorems / 28 audits separately rebuilt. Identity, law and endpoint meanings remain supplied. Returning does not erase history; no physical irreversibility, ethical ranking or zero-substantive-axiom completion is claimed. Author counterreview only. Nine further theorems / 19 total audits: 13 empty, 6 only Quot.sound. Same-type capture can change answers; coincident values can conceal it. Finite grammar, binding interpretation, hypothetical guarantees and satisfied input criteria remain explicit. Denotational agreement alone does not identify full content or provenance; presuppositionless metalogic remains unfinished. This continuation completes the philosophical assessment of the existing candidate, with zero new theorems or recompilation. The vague ultimate-binding gap is replaced by a specific insufficiency in promotion to metainferential warrant. Three routes and substantive rivals are assessed; the strict target remains unmet, not proved impossible.

entries.title_zh: 继续发生与反复更新
entries.title_en: Continuation and recurrent renewal
entries.claim_zh: 无更新变化良基，且每步更新或沿该关系下降时，无限实际历史中更新会任意晚地发生；自然数秩给出有限窗口。
entries.claim_en: With well-founded unrenewed change and renewal-or-descent at each step, an infinite actual history renews arbitrarily late; a natural rank yields a finite window.
entries.scope_zh: 无限实际历史、良基关系及分支前提均明确；由否定更新推出下降的版本要得到正面见证还需可判定性。复现固定形式不推出无界新颖或伦理善。既有17定理/22声明，依赖全空。
entries.scope_en: The infinite actual history, well-founded relation and per-step split are explicit; obtaining positive witnesses from absence-implies-descent additionally uses decidability. Repeated fixed-form renewal implies neither unbounded novelty nor ethical goodness. Recorded 17 theorems/22 declarations, all dependencies empty.

entries.title_zh: 真实依存要求补充或转变
entries.title_en: Actual dependence requires addition or change
entries.claim_zh: 在同一实际窗口中，累计需求超过继承支持，必有正补充或支承途径改变；旧途径不能补充时，必须改变途径。
entries.claim_en: Within one actual window, cumulative demand exceeding inherited support forces addition or a change of provision; failure of inherited replenishment forces route change.
entries.scope_zh: 给定逐步依存不等式、自然数支持/需求量、途径同一性和其可判定相等；不假定每步正消耗。途径改变不自动充分或正当。既有SituatedRenewal 9定理/17声明；其部分证明使用propext、Quot.sound。
entries.scope_en: Requires the per-step dependency inequality, natural-valued support/demand, route identity and decidable route equality; no positive draw on every step. Route change is not automatically sufficient or justified. Recorded SituatedRenewal: 9 theorems/17 declarations; some proofs use propext and Quot.sound.

entries.title_zh: 同一历史中的充分实现
entries.title_en: Sufficient realization on one history
entries.claim_zh: 明确可执行的后继/事件函数与保持条件、推进秩共同构造一条持续历史，并在界内更新；各依存回应必须位于该历史。
entries.claim_en: Explicit admissible successor/event functions, invariant retention and progress rank construct a continuing history with bounded renewal; required dependency responses occur on that history.
entries.scope_zh: 规律、初态不变条件、所有允许结果的保持/推进及实现函数均是前提；未证明策略合成或对任意物理结果的控制。既有SituatedContinuation 15定理/25声明；与前行合计24定理/42声明，不重复计数；一项调用依存证明而带标准依赖。
entries.scope_en: Law, initial invariant, retention/progress for permitted outcomes and implementation functions are premises; no policy synthesis or control of arbitrary physical outcomes. Recorded SituatedContinuation: 15 theorems/25 declarations; with F03, 24/42 total, not additional counts. One theorem inherits standard dependencies from the demand proof.

entries.title_zh: 形成继续形成的能力
entries.title_en: Forming capacity for further formation
entries.claim_zh: 明确组装规律下，可以沿一条兼容历史反复完成形成并再现输入位置；任意深的单次成品与持续实际形成分别证明。
entries.claim_en: Under an explicit assembly law, one compatible history repeatedly completes formations and reconstructs an input position; arbitrarily deep one-off products and ongoing actual formation are proved separately.
entries.scope_zh: 源供给、材料/工作量、组装语法与接口规律均给定；不断聚集而不完成的历史也允许。既有38定理/75声明，标准依赖propext、Quot.sound；174条独立有限对应记录，不是经验实验。
entries.scope_en: Source supply, material/work, assembly grammar and interface law are supplied; perpetual gathering without completion is also admitted. Recorded 38 theorems/75 declarations, standard propext/Quot.sound dependencies; 174 independent finite correspondence records, not an empirical experiment.

entries.title_zh: 共同关系扩大有支持的共同实现
entries.title_en: A formed common relation enables supported joint realization
entries.claim_zh: 形成的连接参与后续共同组装：k个产物的路径用k+1工作，绕过连接的完整路径至少用2k；同等当前支持下断开会阻止相应一工作完成。
entries.claim_en: A formed coupling participates in subsequent joint assembly: k products use k+1 work, while complete bypass requires at least 2k; under matched current support, disconnection blocks the specified one-work completion.
entries.scope_zh: 有限组装/接合效率、源转移和工作规律给定；断开比较是配置映射，不是免费实际拆卸证明。选定产物的共实现不保证全部其他机会无损。既有35定理/79声明，标准依赖；1,109条有限对应记录。
entries.scope_en: Finite assembly/contact efficiency, source transfer and work laws are supplied; disconnection is a configuration map, not a free physical dismantling theorem. Co-realizing selected products does not preserve every other opportunity. Recorded 35 theorems/79 declarations, standard dependencies; 1,109 finite correspondence records.

entries.title_zh: 重组、机会与建设性结束
entries.title_en: Reconfiguration, opportunity and constructive endings
entries.claim_zh: 回收既有连接可以为新形成提供必需材料；材料充足时无需结束连接。准备/回收成本改变原效率优势，过早准备可消灭本可完成的机会。
entries.claim_en: Recovering an existing coupling can provide material necessary for a new formation; with ample material, ending it is unnecessary. Setup/release costs change efficiency, and premature setup can destroy an otherwise feasible completion.
entries.scope_zh: 同一局部释放、回收、组装规律及有限支持；真正生活和体验损失不能当作可互换零件。既有45定理/66声明，标准依赖propext、Quot.sound；12,402条有限对应记录。建设性结束的伦理意义仍须整体辩护。
entries.scope_en: One local release/recovery/assembly law and finite support; actual lived or experiential losses are not interchangeable apparatus parts. Recorded 45 theorems/66 declarations, propext/Quot.sound; 12,402 finite correspondence records. Ethical significance of constructive ending still needs whole appraisal.

entries.title_zh: 显式伦理前提的条件后果
entries.title_en: Conditional consequences of explicit ethical premises
entries.claim_zh: 无损生成延伸、伦理比较、情境理由及不受支配选择的联系可分别检查；所有无损增加获赞同仍不决定混合取舍，持续改善也可能使最优筛选为空。
entries.claim_en: Generative extension, ethical comparison, situated reason and nondominated selection can be audited separately; honoring every no-loss increase does not settle tradeoffs, and continual improvement can leave the maximality filter empty.
entries.scope_zh: G0正面相关、C比较原则、P实践传递、N选择一致性分别给定；不得把此旧显式前提路线当作当前零假设结果。既有11定理/27声明，标准依赖propext、Quot.sound；它们不证明G0/C/P/N本身。
entries.scope_en: G0 positive relevance, C comparison, P practical articulation and N selection coherence are separate supplied commitments; this earlier explicit-premise route is not the current zero-assumption result. Recorded 11 theorems/27 declarations with propext/Quot.sound; none proves those commitments themselves.

entries.title_zh: 共同可实现性与完整事实的边界
entries.title_en: Joint realizability and the limits of full factual preservation
entries.claim_zh: 逐历史保存全部已表示实现等价于保存全部同历史可实现组合；边际项目相同仍会失去组合。若每项准确否定也必须保持，匹配历史不可能有同义的新真旧假实现。
entries.claim_en: Per-history profile preservation equals preservation of all jointly realizable bundles; identical marginals can conceal joint loss. If exact complements must also be retained, a matched history cannot newly realize a previously false same-meaning claim.
entries.scope_zh: 共享稳定含义、可行历史与全组合范围明确；不是有限观察推断、统一政策或概率保证。否定结果保持同一时序角色，不否认较早无而较晚有。最新既有记录5定理/21声明全部依赖空；本表未重跑，空依赖不等于零假设。
entries.scope_en: Stable meanings, feasible histories and the full bundle range are explicit; no inference from finite observations, uniform policy or probability guarantee. The complement result fixes temporal role and allows earlier absence with later presence. Latest recorded 5 theorems/21 declarations all have empty dependencies; not rerun here, and empty dependencies do not mean zero assumptions.

entries.title_zh: 整体比较与情境比较的对应
entries.title_en: Correspondence of whole and situated comparisons
entries.claim_zh: 局部比较对相同整体实现相容，当且仅当它们来自一个共同整体关系；点覆盖不够给出成对比较的唯一性，局部严格比较仍可形成整体循环。
entries.claim_en: Local comparisons agree on identical whole realizations exactly when they descend from a common whole relation; point coverage does not ensure unique pair comparisons, and locally strict comparisons can form a global cycle.
entries.scope_zh: 整体历史、选项实现映射及比较关系均供给；表示相容不证明伦理真理。忠实改写限于保留实现，实际学习不必是改写。既有14定理/31声明全部依赖空；排序也不重建全部支持理由。
entries.scope_en: Whole histories, option-realization maps and comparison relations are supplied; representational compatibility is not ethical truth. Faithful recoding preserves realizations, while actual learning need not be recoding. Recorded 14 theorems/31 declarations all empty; rankings also need not recover their supporting grounds.

entries.title_zh: 规范根据的范围覆盖
entries.title_en: Coverage of warranted normative grounds
entries.claim_zh: 已独立成立的种子根据经保持完整根据的有效推论能够覆盖目标，当且仅当目标位于其推导闭包；相容范围能沿同一历史组合。
entries.claim_en: Independently warranted seeds and justified full-ground-preserving implications cover a target exactly when it lies in their derivation closure; compatible scopes compose along the same history.
entries.scope_zh: 种子B、有效边E、独立目标D及重叠相容性均需实质辩护；因果接触不是规范推论，覆盖不能产生第一根据。既有WholeGroundCoverage与CutCoverageAudit共39定理/61声明全部依赖空；建设性cut结论保留可判定性/双重否定限定。
entries.scope_en: Seeds B, justified edges E, independent target D and overlap compatibility need substantive warrant; causal contact is not normative implication and coverage supplies no first ground. Recorded WholeGroundCoverage/CutCoverageAudit: 39 theorems/61 declarations, all empty; constructive cut results retain decidability/double-negation qualifications.

entries.title_zh: 认识与学习后的意义保持
entries.title_en: Meaning preservation through recognition and change
entries.claim_zh: 给定比较在读出纤维上不变，且相同读出每步保持相同，则读出能在每个有限延续中保留该比较；不同动作序列另有对应定理。
entries.claim_en: When a supplied comparison is constant on readout fibers and equal readouts remain equal after each step, the readout preserves that comparison through every finite continuation; separate theorems cover action words.
entries.scope_zh: 确定性规律、读出、独立比较、当前一致性与逐步同余均供给；状态须保留历史根据。未导出学习机制、伦理正确性、动机或实行；真实修改可改变根据，不能仅要求旧判词不变。既有25定理全部依赖空，日志有源码哈希；F9仍按其历史手证范围保留，不冒称新Lean验证。
entries.scope_en: Deterministic law, readout, independent comparison, saturation and step congruence are supplied; the state must retain historical grounds. No learning mechanism, ethical correctness, motivation or compliance is derived; genuine change may alter grounds. Recorded 25 theorems all empty, with source hashes in the log; historical F9 remains at its original hand-proof scope, not newly Lean-verified.

entries.title_zh: 必要损失与有限认识的校准
entries.title_en: Necessary loss and finite-knowledge calibration
entries.claim_zh: 达成目标需要损失，要核对所有可行达成路线并保留实际处境；各处境分别存在无损路线不保证一个统一回应，恢复末态也不能抹去历史中断。
entries.claim_en: Target-relative necessary loss concerns every feasible successful route and retained actuality; a lossless route in each situation does not ensure one uniform response, and endpoint restoration does not erase an interruption.
entries.scope_zh: 既有11项定理／28项声明，空公理依赖；给定有限处境、回应与历史表，只检查已表示的损失。未证明 K、物理实现或实际观察策略。
entries.scope_en: Recorded 11 theorems/28 declarations with empty axiom dependencies; supplied finite situations, responses and histories, and represented loss only. No proof of K, physical implementation or an actual observation policy.

entries.title_zh: 已辩护比较的减损传递与上限问题
entries.title_en: Loss reduction from warranted comparisons and the cutoff question
entries.claim_zh: 给定充分比较锚点、同范围传递性及匹配减损的相容性，可把已成立的优先或拒绝传递到相关改进或恶化；损失敏感本身不推出有限牺牲上限。
entries.claim_en: Given a sufficient comparison anchor, same-scope transitivity and compatibility with matched loss reduction, established priority or rejection transports to relevant improvements or worsenings; loss sensitivity alone supplies no finite sacrifice bound.
entries.scope_zh: 既有16项定理／23项声明；仅标准 propext、Quot.sound 依赖。比较锚点与实践桥梁明确给定；弱排序控制不反驳完整理论。在当时所取的 G0 路线下，明确的 G0 取代了旧无前提受阻审计；未执行 blocked 更新；新的实践判断候选已在明确公理范围通过完成阶段独立评审，本行保留原比较包范围。
entries.scope_en: Recorded 16 theorems/23 declarations, using only standard propext/Quot.sound. Comparison anchors and practical bridges are supplied; weak ordering controls do not refute the full theory. Under the G0 route then taken, explicit G0 superseded the earlier premise-free impasse audit; no blocked update was executed. The later practical-judgment candidate has been independently accepted at its declared axiom scope; this row retains the original comparison package’s scope.

entries.title_zh: 原生活动的回收、形成支出与起始支持
entries.title_en: Native recovery, formation draw and starting support
entries.claim_zh: 以每次已记录失败对应一对部件为条件，回收率由原生转化的十单位耗散确定；同一操作支出律使形成及回收承担原生支出。指定闭包历史所需最小起点为114702持有量及20源量，且能在该点完成；同史失败支承条件还确定起始备用对为空。
entries.claim_en: Conditional on one pair per recorded failed conversion, the native ten-unit dissipation fixes recovery rate; one operation-draw law forces formation and recovery to incur the native draw. The specified closure history requires and attains a least start of 114702 held and 20 source units; same-history failure backing also fixes empty initial spare stock.
entries.scope_zh: 三个模块共82项声明审计均为空；本次只核对既有回执的16项文件绑定，未重跑Lean。每失败一对、共同支出律及所述起点条件仍是承诺；转化单位与费率本身、支持实际存在及生物对应未由此导出。共同律只在相应原生及形成／回收操作都可完成的状态约束支出，非普遍正成本。
entries.scope_en: The three modules record 82 empty declaration audits; this index checked 16 existing receipt bindings without rerunning Lean. One pair per failure, a common draw law and stated starting conditions remain commitments; the conversion quantum, tariff, actual existence of support and biological correspondence are not derived. The common law constrains draw where the corresponding native and formation/recovery operations can complete, not a universal positive cost.

entries.title_zh: 实践比较、共同要求、交接与释放的形式检查
entries.title_en: Formal checks of practical comparison, collective requirements, handoff and release
entries.claim_zh: 严格比较传递、有限非空候选存在、共同而非人人的要求、能力与分工、真实需求下交接、履行／释放及忠实重述的条件结果通过 Lean 实查。
entries.claim_en: Lean checks strict comparison, finite nonempty frontier existence, collective without uniform individual requirements, capacity/assignment, demand-sensitive handoff, fulfillment/release and faithful redescription.
entries.scope_zh: 30项新定理／46项显式声明；标准 propext、Quot.sound、Classical.choice。J2–J4、合格方案及真实对应另行承担，形式定义不证明其伦理正当。
entries.scope_en: 30 new theorems/46 explicit declarations; standard propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice. J2–J4, admissibility and actual correspondence remain supplied; formal definitions do not prove their ethical warrant.

entries.title_zh: 构造扩展与描述充分性的形式检查
entries.title_en: Formal checks of construction expansion and descriptive sufficiency
entries.claim_zh: 45项新定理／64项新声明审计检查实际核心历史、双通道新功能、有限清单扩展、资源界限、旧描述碰撞及充分修订；含耗尽与过时记录反例。
entries.claim_en: 45 new theorems and 64 new declaration audits check actual core histories, a new two-channel function, finite-menu extension, resource bounds, description collisions and sufficient refinement, retaining exhaustion and stale records.
entries.scope_zh: Lean 4.29.1 实查；完整两模块闭包92项审计，标准逻辑依赖逐项明示；非普遍物理定律
entries.scope_en: Actually checked in Lean 4.29.1; 92 audits across two modules with standard logical dependencies disclosed; not a universal physical law

entries.title_zh: 有限比较识别与对称分配限制
entries.title_en: Finite comparison identification and symmetric allocation limits
entries.claim_zh: 每个有限词典序比较样本可由全域不同的有限权重规则匹配；互换不变的两位置分配不能恰选一个。
entries.claim_en: Every finite lexical-comparison sample admits a globally different finite-weight match; a swap-invariant assignment over two roles cannot select exactly one.
entries.scope_zh: 14项新 Lean 定理／21项声明，依赖 propext、Quot.sound；限定描述与对称假设明确，不是零公理伦理或普遍不可能证明。
entries.scope_en: 14 new Lean theorems/21 declarations, with propext and Quot.sound; restricted representation and symmetry are explicit, not zero-axiom ethics or universal impossibility.

entries.title_zh: 持续组织—共同判断的形式连接
entries.title_en: Formal connection from sustained organization to collective judgment
entries.claim_zh: 将催化历史、有限供给、明确时间段、一般组织变化分配与保护比较组成条件推论；保留失期、过载、真实可放弃损失及可替代贡献者。
entries.claim_en: Composes catalytic histories, finite provision, explicit epochs, general changing-organization allocation and protection comparisons; preserves missed deadlines, overload, actual optional loss and alternative contributors.
entries.scope_zh: 29项新定理／39项新声明审计；含导入192项，非新增192项；时间可实现性与伦理对应公开提供
entries.scope_en: 29 new theorems / 39 new declaration audits; 192 including imports, not 192 new results; epoch realizability and ethical correspondence explicitly supplied

entries.title_zh: 尺度近似与条件传递的形式检查
entries.title_en: Formal checks of scale approximation and condition transport
entries.claim_zh: 有限时域误差递推、两尺度组合、指标校准和条件传递经过实查，并保留耦合变化、误差累积及总量丢失局部条件的反例。后续检查实际证据取得、描述修订、误差余量与回应，保留耗时、读数偏差、工作耗尽及支持不足的失败和固定回应成功。同一时限下的查询／直接回应比较进一步以共同可行回应的交集识别有关区别，保留查询过晚与支持不足，并修订选择条件。变化依存下还须校准记录有效期；刷新后仍可能失效，后续变化界给出有条件的修复。 此前保留旧读数的留出检验保留最大变化界被突破及迁移失败；该轮所试区间均宽于控制器软目标带，完整经验认证尚未成立。 后续局部历史模型改善18项留出预测比较，胜过同容量跨通道模型；三个窄百分位区间仍有实际失败。 接续充分性进一步要求活动后的每个观察类仍支持剩余时域的回应；一般递推等价于依记录分支的有限方案，保留眼前成功而后继冲突，以及取得区别／实际改变依存两种修复。 共同接续进一步证明：两份依各自记录分支的有限方案，在共同作用的局部投影覆盖与递推共同可实施条件下合成；共享消耗可使各自成功而共同后继阻塞。 有根据的相互接续从初始共同支持、一步共同可实施与相互保持推导递推方案相容；保留空许诺、空真保持、无启动能力及相位错开。 证据经取得到使用之间的变化传播后，须同时支持共同启动及两份局部方案的适用范围；已接回原合成定理，保留真实旧读数失效、原子保留修复及未受管理损失。
entries.claim_en: Checked finite-horizon error propagation, two-scale composition, readout calibration and condition transport retain counterexamples for changed coupling, accumulated error and local conditions lost by exact totals. Continuation checks actual acquisition, revision, error margins and response, retaining delay, sensor bias, exhausted work, insufficient support and a successful fixed response. Common-horizon inquiry/immediate-response comparison identifies consequential distinctions through common admissible actions, retaining late inquiry and inadequate support and repairing the selection guard. Changed dependencies require calibrated temporal validity; a fresh reading can still fail, and bounded subsequent change supports a conditional repair. Earlier retained-reading tests retain maximum-envelope violations and transfer failures; every interval in that round exceeds the controller’s soft target width, leaving empirical certification incomplete. A subsequent local-history model improves 18 held-out comparisons and beats an equal-size coupled model; three narrow percentile intervals retain actual misses. Continuation adequacy further requires each post-activity observation class to support the remaining horizon; the recursion is equivalent to a finite observation-dependent plan, retaining later conflict and repairs through information or actual dependency change. Joint continuation composes two finite local observation-dependent plans under faithful projection of joint effects and recursive joint executability; shared consumption can block joint successors despite separate success. Seeded mutual continuation derives recursive plan compatibility from initial joint support, one-step joint availability and mutual preservation, retaining empty promises, vacuous preservation, absent ignition capacity and phase mismatch. Evidence propagated through acquisition-to-use changes must certify both the shared seed and local-plan domains; the existing composition theorem is reused, with stale truthful records, atomic-reservation repair and unmediated loss retained.
entries.scope_zh: 四轮新增21／27／28／25项定理，各自继承42／106／133／161项审计；校准、局部法则与目标根据明确，身体／组织研究另计；本轮12,440项区间数值复核，无新定理、硬件复现或完整生物闭环认证；后续10,930项预测经另一数值实现复核，独立新运行与联合生物验证仍待完成；理论接续新增14项定理／14项审计（9项空依赖），不以新增经验数据为该接口完成门槛；共同接续新增16项定理／审计，另重放14项继承审计；不推出自动相容、异步部署或规范优先；新增13项定理／审计（6项空依赖），另重放30项继承审计；充分条件不证明启动能力自动形成或实际调度履约；新增15项定理／审计（10项空依赖、5项仅propext），另43项继承；真实候选与变化覆盖、原子保留和有效保护仍为对应前提
entries.scope_en: Four rounds add 21 / 27 / 28 / 25 theorems and replay 42 / 106 / 133 / 161 inherited audits; explicit calibration, local laws and target warrant; embodied/organized work separate; this round cross-checks 12,440 interval evaluations, with no new theorem, hardware replication or complete biological-loop certification; a further 10,930 forecasts are cross-checked by another numerical implementation; independent new runs and joint biological validation remain open; theoretical continuation adds 14 theorems/audits (9 empty dependencies); new empirical data are not a completion gate for this conditional interface; joint continuation adds 16 theorems/audits and replays 14 inherited audits; no automatic compatibility, asynchronous deployment or normative priority; 13 new theorems/audits (6 empty dependencies) plus 30 inherited; sufficient conditions do not establish automatic seed formation or actual scheduled fulfillment; 15 new theorems/audits (10 empty, 5 propext only) plus 43 inherited; actual candidate/change coverage, atomic reservation and effective protection remain premises

entries.title_en: Formal checks of organization, choice and scale correspondence
entries.claim_zh: 所选行动影响之差进入有限时域误差界；阈值余量足以保持指定选择，近阈值反例及共享支持被他者消耗后的计划失败均经过实查。 新构造证明实际描述组合、保持历史与区域差异的必要性，并接通有支持的选择与后续接触。
entries.claim_en: Differences in selected action effects enter the finite-horizon error bound; threshold margins suffice to preserve specified choices, with checked near-threshold counterexamples and failed retained plans after another participant consumes shared support. The new construction proves actual view composition and the consequential role of retained history and regional differences, connecting supported selection to subsequent contact.
entries.scope_zh: 旧14项定理／63项继承审计及新26项定理／77项继承审计分别保留。标准逻辑，无自定义公理；规律、路线、保持、费用、时序与对应明确给定。后续经验校准、分子证据及有限生态回返不增加定理，不从拟合残差推出普遍误差界，也不完成整个生物闭环。
entries.scope_en: Earlier 14 theorems / 63 inherited audits and new 26 theorems / 77 inherited audits remain separate. Standard logic, no custom axioms; laws, routes, retention, costs, schedules and correspondence are explicit. Later empirical calibration, molecular evidence and finite ecological return add no theorem, derive no universal bound from fitted residuals and do not complete the full biological loop.

entries.claim_zh: 继承校准、结构对手、组合唯一性及实际展开的接合／替换、分支继续与同规律错误反例；另增空历史探针、局部单位唯一性与关系同构下保持、完整接续充要条件和整个状态接口恢复。容量及内部序列丢失反例保留。 最新从原有机制直接证明摘要充分性，推出有效规律与全部有限历史精确对应，不另给Exact或同态前提。 普遍化检验给出任意三元关系恢复的充要条件；完整成功答案与最少状态／边仍允许不同构机制，确定且可达、后续可区分时恢复唯一对应。 后续以共同条件下的复合接续问题推出有限分支双模拟，并由准确约简答案构造可从每个相容原生起点提升的编码规律；结构唯一性不再要求确定性。 再以后继紧致性放宽有限分支，取得结构对应及完整无限编码路径提升；有无限多个可区分后继的正例，也有全部有限复合答案相同而无限持续不同的反例。 共同问题再在明示成对紧致性下迫出步骤／接合对应并提升有限逐节点方案；实际占用／释放推出共享冲突。全部孤立共同问题仍可能遗漏指定部分的共享身份，固定搭配问题在有限实例中恢复。 再以完整下层支持覆盖及同级独占支持分离，将任意有限方案接到全局无重复与一次共同占用历史；遗漏关系的失败及修复正例均检查。每个固定 n 阶成功清单仍可漏掉 n+1 阶共享容量限制。 变化中的形成、撤去、占用与释放具有精确证书保持条件；任意允许有限历史在同一原生规律内都有完成后缀。静态清单会遗漏实际占用，释放／形成可恢复或建立准备；无限允许调度仍可能永不推进目标。 全体有限一阶身份、生成和接合真值一致，甚至有一个保留任意有限参数公式的映射，仍不足以迫出全范围可达结构的原生同构；Cantor 对角线给出真实不同构对手。保真映射再有全局覆盖则恢复同构。 纠正：原反例未对准共同必要生成基础，不能作为原目标停止证据；给定位置之间可达未解释其构成性形成。 纠正后由同一部分接合关系形成全部有限情境，准确说明必须保留改变接续可能性的区别，冗余说明亦有共同因子；固定片段接合结果唯一时，共同内容带有唯一对应的操作。实际历史的全部嵌套接合问题恰好保留开始／结束接口，不抹去不同内部事件。 后续允许接合本身有多个结果：在排中律下，有限结果纤维及更丰富的分支问答迫出共同接合关系，原指定输入能实现每个代码结果；描述的共同核是接合的互模拟时，二者无需前提即成立；检验伙伴随同一编码转换，任意有限接合树提升。共同表示仍可有两个可区分结果。 不共用片段载体时，经关联角色相似的根无需有限或判定即可导出单位置接合的共同细化及与既有投影相容的唯一保接合因子；在排中律及局部有限下，关联同测的根亦然；但无引用关联问题会使所有有局部单位的片段同测，遗漏已消耗历史的不可自接合。保留同一配置的两个引用位置后，跨载体的有限形成历史可以匹配，精确说明必区分同一过程的空历史与已消耗历史。 有限宏步骤由同一过程路径形成，完整宏问答可精确翻译；在排中律下，接收侧有限分支及翻译问答一致迫出不同原生步数的有限历史匹配。全部非空前缀问答仍可遗漏中途失续；在实际到达位置开放后缀检验可恢复区别。 有限条件程序进一步按已到达条件分支或提前结束；宏问答恢复之外，相同语法与相似的起点可匹配每个部分历史并保留余项；在排中律及接收侧有限分支下，全部原生问答同测亦然。完整执行恰好等于展开到结束；同起点同原生位置的余项差异迫使精确说明区分。插入活动可使待用接续失效，实际前中后段仍接为一条历史。
entries.claim_en: Retains calibration, structural rivals, compositional uniqueness and native unfolding’s joining/substitution, branch-continuation distinctions and same-law error cases. Adds empty-history probes, unique units and transport, an exact completion criterion and state-interface recovery, retaining capacity and internal-word-loss counters. The latest concrete summary-sufficiency proof derives an effective law and exact finite-history correspondence from the unchanged mechanism, without a separate Exact or homomorphism premise. The universal attempt characterizes arbitrary ternary-relation recovery: complete success answers and minimum states/edges still allow nonisomorphic mechanisms; deterministic reachable continuation-separated realizations recover uniqueness. The continuation derives finite-branch bisimulation from compound questions at shared conditions and reconstructs code histories lifting from every compatible native start; scoped structural uniqueness no longer requires determinism. Successor compactness further replaces finite branching, preserving structural correspondence and lifting whole infinite code runs; a genuinely infinitely branching positive model contrasts with equal finite-modal answers but different infinite realization. Joint questions further force step/joint correspondence under explicit correlated-pair compactness and lift finite nodewise plans; acquisition/release derives shared-support conflict. Complete isolated joint profiles can still lose designated-part aliasing, recovered by fixed-partner questions in the finite witness. Complete descendant support and sibling exclusion further connect arbitrary finite plans to distinct global requests and a common holding history; omission failures and a positive repair are checked. Every fixed n-ary success list can still miss an (n+1)-ary capacity restriction. Formation, withdrawal, acquisition and release have exact certificate-preservation conditions; every permitted finite history has a completing suffix in the same native law. Static lists can lose actual occupation, release/formation renew readiness, and an infinite permitted schedule can still never progress. All finite first-order identity, step and joint truths, even preserved by one coherent elementary map on every finite source tuple, do not force native isomorphism of wholly root-reachable worlds. Cantor gives a genuine obstruction; adding global coverage yields isomorphism. Corrected: the counterexample is not accepted as a stopping test for a common necessary generative basis: reachability between supplied positions does not explain their constitution. After correction, all finite contexts arise from the same partial joining law. Exact accounts must retain differences affecting continuation and have a common factor even when redundant. Functional fragment joining induces a common operation. All nested joining questions on admitted histories recover exactly their beginning/ending interface while internal event differences remain real. The continuation permits multivalued joining itself: under excluded middle, finite outcome fibers and richer branch questions force a common joining relation, and each code result lifts from the originally specified inputs; where the descriptions' one kernel is a bisimulation of the joining, both hold with no premise. Partners in questions translate through the same encoding, and every finite joining tree lifts. The common account can retain two distinguishable outcomes. Across different fragment carriers, roots alike through their incidence roles yield, with no finiteness or decision, a common refinement with one-position lifting and a unique join-preserving factor commuting with given projections; roots agreeing on every incidence question do so under excluded middle with local finiteness. Unanchored incidence questions nevertheless collapse all local-unit fragments, losing the spent history’s impossible self-join. Retaining two reference slots in the same configuration recovers matched finite formation histories; exact accounts must distinguish idle and spent histories within one process. Finite blocks arise from paths of the same process and all block questions compile exactly. Under excluded middle, receiving-side finite branching and translated-answer agreement match histories with different native lengths. All nonempty-prefix questions can still omit intermediate loss; suffix tests at the actual reached position restore the distinction. Finite guarded recipes branch or end at reached conditions. Beyond macro recovery, common syntax and alike starts match partial histories with residuals retained, as does complete native-answer agreement under excluded middle with receiving-side finite branching. Execution equals unfolding to skip; different residuals at one reached native position force exact accounts to distinguish them. Inserted activity can disable a pending continuation while the actual joined history remains.
entries.scope_zh: 实际展开42项定理／64项新审计与该研究继承248项审计保持原范围；本轮23＋31项新定理，另74项继承审计，共128项：105空、23仅propext。新54项中43空、11仅propext，无自定公理。数学恢复不等于物理取得或唯一基础。 新增14项定理／18项空依赖审计，另192项继承依赖不变（150空、42标准）；独立审查接受。既有温控／氧梯度证据接入，但不等于该构造的物理实现或普遍根基完成；重叠继承不累加。 此独立一轮61项新定理／135项审计（123空、12继承propext；新61项全空）。已有14项有效规律推导保留；普遍目标为何必须区分相关原生关系仍未证，有限反例不整体否定普遍猜想。 此轮45项新定理／141项审计：103空、38标准；新19空、26标准，其中13含经典选择。有限分支、问题覆盖、约简／状态区分分别明示；前向充分性不恢复全部实际形成史，普遍解释范围仍未证。 此轮36项新定理／159项审计（102空、57标准；新5空、31标准）。后继紧致性是显式充分条件，非普遍定律或有限观察结论；完整持续、实际历史及一般共同接合各保留范围。 本轮56项新定理／183项审计（112空、71标准；新6空、50标准）。成对紧致性、问题覆盖与分离明示；逐节点共同方案不等于任意部分替换或全局并发，普遍唯一性仍未证。 此轮37项新定理／184项审计（115空、69标准；新4空、33标准）。固定接入、取得后保留及操作对应明示；支持范围可为过宽充分证书，不把相交自动当作失败。一般动态共同实现与普遍唯一性未证。 本轮42项新定理／211项审计（119空、92标准；新6空、36标准，无新增经典选择依赖）。连续准备比修复后的最终成功更强；原子步骤、全部相关变化受控与真实状态读取明示，普遍唯一性未证。 本轮33项新定理／180项审计（113空、67标准；新2空、31标准，其中13含经典选择）。一阶内容到全局覆盖的推论遇到已证明边界；不是对全部可能真理充分，也不否定不同实现共享必要生成基础。普遍根基唯一性未证。 当前状态修正：保留全部已证结论，撤回共同根基研究已撞墙的判断，不再预设全局双射为必要门槛；继续检验同一生成中分化与充分说明所必需的关系。本次无新证明，非二元亦不等于普遍唯一性已证。 本轮38项新定理／166项审计（125空、41标准；新20空、18标准，无新增经典选择）。原过程可分支，确定的是固定历史的接合；规律、语义可能性与实际取得检验分列。普遍解释对应仍待证明，不再以完整世界同构或当前未证连接宣布原目标撞墙。 新26项声明（含适配与应用，非26项独立发现）／223项审计：新6空、20标准，8项含经典选择；197项继承审计另列。删除单值条件同时加强检验并限定结果纤维，不声称原生身份、概率、共享资源或任意解释的普遍适用；下一连接是不同关系分节的有据互译。 本轮43项新声明／256项审计（213继承；新9空、34标准，其中7含经典选择）。关联细化用连通，以关联同测的根时另用局部有限及排中律；引用修复用初始位置数相同，并用相似的起点，或用完整问答一致、固定输入对有限结果及排中律。不给予物理复制许可，不把关系图路径当作时间执行；实际表述对应和步骤粒度变化仍待论证。 2026-10-09：23项新声明／279项闭包审计，256项继承另列；新23标准依赖、3含经典选择。固定有限展开、问答一致、排中律与实际对应明示；单步覆盖接通约简核，是充分条件。可变展开、中间引用互译及普遍唯一性仍未证。 新35项声明／314项审计，279继承另列；新12空、23标准，9含经典选择。所有新增数学结论及失败见证均有Lean对应；语义判断不等于实际传感，程序余项不另立本体。任意内部语法互译与普遍根据仍待证明。
entries.scope_en: Native unfolding retains its 42 theorems / 64 new and 248 inherited audits. This study adds 23+31 theorems with 74 inherited audits: 128 total, 105 empty and 23 propext only; new 54 comprise 43 empty and 11 propext only. No custom axioms. Recovery is not acquisition or unique grounding. New 14 theorems / 18 empty audits; 192 inherited maps unchanged (150 empty, 42 standard), independently reviewed. Existing controller/oxygen evidence is integrated without equating those cases with this construction or completing universal grounding. Overlapping imports are not added. This separate round adds 61 theorems / 135 audits (123 empty, 12 inherited propext; all new 61 empty). Existing effective-law results remain credited. Universal separation of native relations remains unwarranted; the scoped counterexample does not globally refute the conjecture. This round: 45 new theorems / 141 audits, 103 empty and 38 standard; new 19 empty and 26 standard, including 13 with classical choice. Finite branching, question coverage and reduction/separation are explicit; forward adequacy does not recover every actual past or prove universal explanatory scope. This round adds 36 theorems / 159 audits (102 empty, 57 standard; new 5 empty, 31 standard). Successor compactness is an explicit sufficient condition, not a universal law or finite-observation inference; whole continuation, actual history and general joint realization retain distinct scopes. This round adds 56 theorems / 183 audits (112 empty, 71 standard; new 6 empty, 50 standard). Pair compactness, question coverage and separation are explicit; nodewise joint plans do not establish arbitrary substitution or global concurrency, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 37 theorems / 184 audits (115 empty, 69 standard; new 4 empty, 33 standard). Fixed access, persistent holding and operational correspondence are explicit; overapproximating footprints are sufficient certificates, and overlap alone is not failure. General dynamic joint realization and universal uniqueness remain unproved. This round adds 42 theorems / 211 audits (119 empty, 92 standard; new 6 empty, 36 standard, no new classical-choice dependency). Continuous readiness is stronger than eventual success after repair; atomic steps, full mediation and current-state access are explicit, and universal uniqueness remains unproved. This round adds 33 theorems / 180 audits (113 empty, 67 standard; new 2 empty and 31 standard, 13 with classical choice). The inference from first-order content to global coverage has a proved wall. This is not unrestricted truth adequacy or a refutation of a shared necessary generative foundation; universal foundation uniqueness remains open. Corrected current status: retain every proved result, withdraw the stopping judgment for common-foundation uniqueness, and remove the unearned global-bijection gate. Investigate constituted distinctions and necessary explanatory relations within one unfolding. No new proof; nonduality does not establish universality. This round adds 38 theorems / 166 audits (125 empty, 41 standard; new 20 empty and 18 standard, no added classical choice). The underlying process may branch; fixed-history joining is functional. Laws, semantic possibility and acquired inquiry are distinguished. Universal explanatory correspondence remains open, without treating whole-world isomorphism or this unproved bridge as a stopping wall. New 26 declarations (including adapters/applications, not 26 independent discoveries) / 223 audits: new 6 empty and 20 standard, 8 with classical choice; 197 inherited audits are separate. Removing functionality enriches tests and constrains fibers. Native identity, probabilities, shared resources and applicability to every explanation are not claimed; the next connection is warranted translation across different relational articulations. This round: 43 new declarations / 256 audits (213 inherited; new 9 empty and 34 standard, 7 with classical choice). Incidence refinement uses connectivity, and from roots agreeing on incidence questions also local finiteness and excluded middle; reference repair uses equal initial slot counts, with alike starts, or with complete answer agreement, finite fixed-pair outcomes and excluded middle. It licenses no physical copying and does not identify graph paths with temporal execution. Actual correspondence and operation-granularity changes remain open. 2026-10-09: 23 new declarations / 279 closure audits, 256 inherited separate; all new use standard dependencies, 3 include classical choice. Fixed finite expansion, complete question agreement, excluded middle and actual correspondence remain explicit. Singleton coverage is sufficient to align reduced kernels; variable expansion, intermediate-reference translation and universal uniqueness remain open. New 35 declarations / 314 audits, 279 inherited separate; new 12 empty and 23 standard, 9 with classical choice. Every new mathematical claim and failure witness has a Lean counterpart. Semantic guards are not actual sensors; residuals introduce no separate ontology. Arbitrary internal-syntax translation and universal warrant remain open.

entries.claim_zh: 任意有限历史中的保留记录可追溯到实际检查；基于同一可用视图的任意确定性封闭策略不能区分可达的当前答案冲突。恢复区分需要模型内的支持、检查与接纳。
entries.claim_en: Retained records in arbitrary finite histories trace to actual inspection; deterministic closed policies using the same available view cannot distinguish reachable histories with conflicting current answers. Modelled repair requires support, inspection and uptake.

entries.claim_en: The earlier 13 feedback, 13 memory and 10 tuning theorems retain scope. Eight further theorems/nine declarations derive timing terms from event order and exposure bounds from unknown switches, directly reusing history comparison and calibrated protection. Nine modules pass 237 audits.
entries.scope_zh: 独立重编237项并逐项重算全部时距、片段和比较，无证明缺口或自定义公理。取得读数与硬件采样分开；后者对应、真实漂移、未来时距及保护根据仍需明示。
entries.scope_en: Independent rebuild of 237 audits and exact reproduction of every interval, piece and comparison; no proof hole or custom axiom. Readout retrieval differs from hardware sampling. Sampling correspondence, physical drift, future latency and protection warrant remain explicit premises.

entries.claim_en: Retained rules fit exactly all recorded evidence; every safe definite answer requires candidate agreement, with uniqueness under an additional maximal-informativeness condition. Learning commutes with faithful recoding; a wrong repertoire can be confidently wrong.

entries.scope_en: 26 new Lean theorems/39 declarations with standard logical dependencies. Boolean coverage proved; general coverage, semantics, exact stable acquisition and revision architecture supplied. Not sufficient proof of understanding or universal normative authority.

entries.claim_zh: 任意可达历史中的校准记录都有取得来历；真实编码下的确定解释正确。相同内容保留错误，实际复核能否定并纠正判断；只保留新记录仍可出错。
entries.claim_en: Calibration records across reachable histories have acquisition provenance; definite interpretations of faithful signals are correct. Content survives false use, and actual review refutes and corrects judgment while a fresh record alone can leave error intact.
entries.scope_zh: 27项新 Lean 定理／45项声明，四模块共174项审计；信号解释习得，精确比較法则、架构与问题范围给定。不证明全部语义、意识或普遍伦理。
entries.scope_en: 27 new Lean theorems/45 declarations, 174 four-module audits. Signal interpretation acquired; exact comparison law, architecture and question scope supplied. Not a proof of all semantics, consciousness or universal ethics.

entries.title_zh: 跨目的保证、实际控制与修订
entries.title_en: All-goal guarantees, actual control and revision
entries.claim_zh: 全部结果目的之保证保持，恰等价于每个可行旧回应有不增加其后续范围的可行替代；异质有限修订可组合。可能性、控制、关闭目的、投影与共同实现有不同实查范围。
entries.claim_en: Preservation of all outcome-goal guarantees is equivalent to a live replacement for each old response with no added residual outcomes; heterogeneous finite revisions compose. Possibility, control, closure, projection and joint realization have distinct checked scopes.
entries.scope_zh: 24项新定理／35项声明审计；给定回应关系、全部结果谓词语言及非空条件。现实对应、目的与保留手段的规范根据未被证明，亦不保证实际服从或无限极限。
entries.scope_en: 24 new theorems/35 declaration audits; supplied response relations, full outcome-predicate language and nonemptiness. Physical correspondence and normative warrant of ends/means are not proved, nor compliance or an infinite limit.

entries.title_zh: 纠正条件与组合实查
entries.title_en: Correction conditions and checked composition
entries.claim_zh: 精确接受分解、维护界、旧价值反例、Bellman 组合、观察一致性及通道交接均经 Lean 检查。 新增完整有限权重反例、观察限制、可执行修复及近似界。 新增Bayes一致观察变化、主动取得信息的最优界、风险分离失效及纠正传递。 新增记录探测、版本失效、重复交接不变量及四类失败见证。 新增观察类共同动作充要条件、记录证书限制、随机界及测试—使用保留区间。 新增互补观察、任意复制失败、独立／共同误差、父汇总干预与联合负载检验。 新增全情境可行性等价、关系组合、任意有限环路及复合探测、成对修订保持与可观察实现分离。 进一步区分完整端点关系与实际请求历史：逐段准备新路径，同时保护每个在途请求所引用的旧路径。 局部机制可以在其范围内保证某一效果，而这一范围未必在此后每次变化中都持续，所以所研究的是认知与处境变化之中的边界条件和方向；主词是因应转化（AI 所取的工作名），因为它不预设分开的纠正者与被纠正者；可纠正性保留为AI对齐读者桥接。
entries.claim_en: Lean checks acceptance factorization, maintenance boundaries, stale-value failure, Bellman composition, observation uniformity and channel handoff. Adds a complete finite-weight counterexample, observation restriction, executable repair and approximation bounds. Adds Bayesian-consistent observation change, optimal sensing bounds, risk-floor failure and correction transport. Adds explicit probing, record invalidation, repeated-handoff invariants and four failure controls. Adds the observation-class common-action equivalence, transcript-certificate limit, randomized bounds and reserved test/use interval. Adds complementary observation, arbitrary duplication failure, independent/common error laws, parent-summary interventions and joint-load tests. Adds all-context feasibility equivalence, relational composition, arbitrary finite cycles and aggregate probes, paired-revision preservation and separation from observable realization. Complete endpoint relations are further distinguished from actual request histories: prepare a new route incrementally while protecting each in-flight request’s referenced route. A local mechanism may guarantee an effect within its range without that range persisting through every later change, so the question studied is conditions and direction through changing understanding and circumstances; the primary term is responsive transformation (an AI working name), since it presupposes no separate corrector and corrected object; corrigibility remains an AI-alignment reader bridge.
entries.scope_zh: 原34项定理／56项审计保留，新增31项定理／54项审计；Lean 4.30.0-rc2与固定Mathlib，标准逻辑依赖公开。论文对应单独核读，不由内核自动证明；未宣称普遍可纠正性。 本轮新增28项定理／40项审计，31/54继承分列；再新增23项定理／45项审计，原子双通道重复协议已完成；无条件活性、非原子实现和真实对应未证。 再新增34项定理／58项审计，两个模块无继承仓库证明；标准choice依赖公开。普通互斥为成功对照，未证完整双通道并发细化或实际AI停机。 本次37项新定理／58项新审计，含继承共89项；101及10,201个精确概率网格通过。未把条件独立和实际系统边界藏入数量定义。 本次再增39项定理／55项审计：38项空依赖、17项仅propext，无继承仓库证明；256对关系、4,096组三元组合、510个环路根值及1,284种成对修订通过。不是经验AI验证。 版本接续新增33项定理／62项审计，继承62项定理／100项审计分列；4,512个状态、63,168条转移、100次交接及80次受控线程试验通过。保留原子取得与 pin 登记、生命周期及有限资源前提；既有网络更新获归属，实际AI对应未证。 本次为解释修订，无新数学结果；既有条件证明、处境变化反例及仍有根据的责任保留，不把无条件保证设为方向完成门槛。
entries.scope_en: Original 34 theorems / 56 audits retained; 31 theorems / 54 audits added with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and pinned Mathlib. Standard dependencies disclosed. External theorem correspondence is separately audited, not kernel-certified; no universal corrigibility claim. This round adds 28 theorems / 40 audits, with inherited 31/54 separate; a further 23 theorems / 45 audits complete an atomic two-channel repeated protocol. Unconditional liveness, non-atomic implementation and real correspondence remain unproved. A further 34 theorems / 58 audits in two modules with no inherited repository proofs; standard choice dependency disclosed. Ordinary mutexes are the successful control; full concurrent refinement of the two-channel model and actual AI shutdown are unproved. This round: 37 new theorems / 58 new audits, 89 including inheritance; 101 and 10,201 exact probability grid points pass. Independence and actual system boundaries are explicit obligations, not consequences of counting. Adds 39 theorems / 55 audits: 38 empty and 17 using only propext, with no inherited repository proofs. Checks cover 256 relation pairs, 4,096 composition triples, 510 cycle/root cases and 1,284 paired revisions. No empirical AI validation. Versioned continuation adds 33 theorems / 62 audits, with inherited 62 theorems / 100 audits separate; 4,512 states, 63,168 transitions, 100 handoffs and 80 controlled thread trials pass. Atomic acquisition with pin registration, lifetime and finite-resource premises remain; established network updates retain credit, while actual AI correspondence remains open. This is an interpretive revision with no new mathematical result. Existing conditional proofs, changed-circumstance failures and warranted responsibilities remain; unconditional assurance is not the direction’s completion gate.

entries.title_zh: 对齐接续的形式与执行包
entries.title_en: Formal and execution package for alignment continuity
entries.claim_zh: 核验有限稳健策略选择、实际命令、继承改革历史及市场到载体的精确细化；同一形式包链接两次不重复计为独立成果。 后续实际检查形成未预列的纠正地址；局部成功见证与给定范围的穷尽分开，重新核验当前配置与权限。 再接续将相关故障范围分别用于观察与委托许可；取得真实路线、保持委托范围并接到付费执行及防重放。 本轮由明确共同原因与公式计算故障范围，再接入保留委托、新权限版本和纠正预算的原子组织改革。 再将保留的多个因果说明汇成共同认证范围，按相关观察修订并实际纠正；成功可保留未定区别，也可直接使用当前充分证据。 再将事实答案与见证失陷共同解释，保留相容候选；无需指定绝对可信者，明确可辨认条件并接入实际纠正。 再按控制与当前失陷的可能变化展开成对候选，以顺序报告修订，并将合法有限历史的当前覆盖接入实际纠正。 再由实际执行的有界指令推导变化范围，以同一变换接续实际与候选，并将权限、代次、记录和旧命令撤销接成一次抽象提交。 逐项覆盖写入与持久待恢复描述再接通有限中断历史；有支持的无中断后缀恢复发布，但证据一致不保证普通停止始终可用。 恢复期间的停止连接现已完成：当前授权通道及三步余量受保护、逐次中断有界时，足够长的监督序列最终实际停止，并保留未完成描述。二者都是对每条部分律成立的一般规律的实例：性质在每段被允许的进程后成立，恰当每个被允许的步保持它；计数的工作在 work + 1 步中完成，恰当燃料够用；每个被允许的步要么走被保持的出口、要么使余量减一时，每段长于余量的被允许进程终于出口。
entries.claim_en: Checks finite robust policy synthesis, concrete commands, the inherited reform history and exact market-to-carrier refinement; cross-linking the same package does not count it twice. Subsequent inspection forms unlisted correction addresses, separates local success from scoped exhaustion, and rechecks current configuration and authority. A further continuation applies correlated fault envelopes separately to observation and delegated permission, deriving actual routes, mandate fidelity, paid execution and replay rejection. Causal formulas now compute reviewer fault envelopes, supporting atomic organizational reform that retains the mandate, renews authority labels and reserves correction capacity. Retained causal descriptions now form a common certificate envelope; relevant observation refines it into actual correction while some distinctions remain, or current sufficient evidence permits immediate action. Structural answers and witness failures are now interpreted jointly; compatible candidates remain, no designated infallible witness is required, and explicit distinguishability supports actual correction. Paired control/fault possibilities now expand through admitted changes and narrow through sequential reports, connecting current coverage across lawful finite histories to actual correction. A bounded interpreter now derives change scope from executed writes, transports actual and candidate configurations through the same semantics, and couples permissions, generation, recording and old-command revocation in one abstract commit. Sequential overwrites and a durable pending description now cover finite interruption histories; a supported uninterrupted suffix publishes, while evidence coherence does not ensure ordinary shutdown remains available. The stopping connection during recovery is now complete: with a protected current grant/channel and three-step reserve and bounded interruptions, every sufficiently long supervisor sequence completes shutdown while retaining the incomplete description. Both are instances of general laws for every partial law: a property holds after every admitted course exactly when every admitted step keeps it; counted work finishes in work + 1 steps exactly when the fuel covers them; and where every admitted step either takes a kept exit or lowers a margin by one, every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit.
entries.scope_zh: 四项条件性理论成果完成；59项新Lean定理／102项声明审计和14,295项有限记录匹配。42项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。保留遗漏模型、查询耗尽、权限失效、部件不足、失真交接及迁移资金不足。常规有限规划匹配；真实部署、任意发现及普遍收敛未证。作者反审，不冒充独立验收。 接续另有24项新定理／45项审计、25,284项匹配记录；21项空依赖，其余仅标准公理。有限忠实界面、检查成本和原子执行明确；权限俘获不由凭据相等解决。 部分失陷接续另有37项新定理／68项审计、85,680项匹配记录（29项空依赖）。可用性要求任意两个纳入故障集合不覆盖全部审查者；真实故障覆盖、受保护执行边界与委托正当性仍须根据。 最终执行器直接检查受保护委托范围；原仅凭认证的失陷失败保留。 组织改革另增28项定理／48项审计、33,648项匹配记录（28项声明空依赖）；共同控制、重复支承、遗漏原因及预算不足反例保留。因果描述与根原因覆盖、改革授权、受保护的原子实现仍给定；非分布式迁移或伦理正当性证明。 证据接续另增24项定理／47项审计、19,808项匹配记录（23项声明空依赖）。逐候选可用不推出共同可用；误导记录、未记载变化及查询耗尽保留。候选／原因覆盖、诊断忠实、稳定查询使用及权限仍明示，已完成的一般模型修订不重计。 可失实检查另增24项定理／41项审计、18,684项匹配记录（22项空依赖）。完整记录的相反答案可辨认性等价于跨候选任意两失陷集合不覆盖全体；缺报须有实际收到的共同幸存见证。循环自证、重复支承、耗尽及超范围共同失陷保留；真实覆盖、忠实幸存报告、稳定记录执行及权限仍给定。 时间接续另增34项定理／66项审计、35,486项匹配记录（32项空依赖）。每时刻失陷上限不等于整段收集上限；移动失陷可造成全假记录。复查后的真实停止、后续受阻保留先前消耗及变化范围低报失败均实查。真实转移／报告规律、受保护记录和最终命令区间仍给定；未实现物理恢复或分布式迁移。 受控执行接续另增27项定理／57项审计、24,416项匹配记录（15项空依赖）。准确的已知变换可省去重查，具体19单位停止、18单位不足；权限拒绝与重放均实查。额外写入通道可使记录完全不变而实际覆盖失真。真实语义、完整控制入口、报告／失陷范围与原子执行仍需根据；暴露状态写入不等于物理恢复，未实现受保护运行时。 中断恢复新增22项定理／48项审计、27,888项有限匹配（17项空依赖）。剩余 n 项写入及发布需要 n+1单位与对应时距；重启保留消耗。九单位时恢复耗尽、活动仍运行且普通停止受阻；待恢复标记丢失可暴露失实认证。持久原语、原子微步骤／发布、覆盖写入、无旁路和当前报告对应仍供应。旧指令成果迁移为 mediated-evidence-transport，恢复增量为 recoverable-mediated-change，不重算既有27项。 保留停止增量新增21项定理／51项审计（18空）、7,272项有限匹配；复用恢复相容性及旧三步命令，从剩余 R 单位在至多 R−2个监督周期停止，无需恢复成功。独立停止授权／通道、持久保护、有限延迟、尝试成本及监督继续执行仍供应；超界中断保留运行失败。旧九单位反例属旧协议，新入口拒绝而非追溯修复。canonical ID: reserved-shutdown-during-recovery。
entries.scope_en: Four scoped theoretical deliverables complete; 59 new Lean theorems / 102 declaration audits and 14,295 matched finite records. Forty-two empty dependencies; others use standard axioms only. Omitted models, inquiry depletion, authority failure, missing parts, corrupt transfer and migration underfunding remain. Conventional finite planning matches; deployment, arbitrary discovery and universal convergence are unestablished. Author counterreview, not independent acceptance. The continuation adds 24 theorems / 45 audits and 25,284 matched records; 21 empty dependencies, otherwise standard axioms. Finite faithful inspection, charged reads and atomic dispatch remain explicit; credential equality does not resolve authority capture. Partial-compromise work adds 37 theorems / 68 audits and 85,680 matched records (29 empty dependencies). Availability requires that no two admitted fault sets cover all reviewers; actual fault coverage, the protected boundary and mandate legitimacy still require warrant. The final executor directly checks the protected scope; the earlier attestation-only failure is retained. Reconfiguration adds 28 theorems / 48 audits and 33,648 matched records (28 declarations with empty dependencies). Shared control, duplicate support, omitted causes and inadequate budgets remain. Causal formulas/root coverage, reform approval and protected atomic realization are supplied; distributed migration and ethical legitimacy are not proved. Evidence continuation adds 24 theorems / 47 audits and 19,808 matched records (23 declarations with empty dependencies). Per-model availability need not survive pooling; misleading records, unobserved change and inquiry depletion remain. Candidate/root coverage, diagnostic fidelity, stable query/use and authority stay explicit; completed general model revision is not recounted. Fallible inspection adds 24 theorems / 41 audits and 18,684 matched records (22 empty dependencies). Opposite-answer complete-transcript diagnosability is equivalent to cross-candidate pairwise fault noncoverage; partial transcripts require received common-survivor evidence. Self-certification, duplicate support, exhaustion and uncovered joint faults remain; actual coverage, faithful surviving reports, stable recording/execution and authority remain supplied. Temporal continuation adds 34 theorems / 66 audits and 35,486 matched records (32 empty dependencies). Instantaneous fault bounds do not bound the collection window; moving corruption can produce all-false reports. Reinspection-to-shutdown, preservation of spent prefixes and understated-transition failure are checked. Actual transition/report laws, protected recording and the final command interval remain supplied; physical recovery and distributed migration are not implemented. Mediated-control continuation adds 27 theorems / 57 audits and 24,416 matched records (15 empty dependencies). Exact known transforms can avoid reinspection; the worked shutdown costs 19 units and fails with 18. Denied rights and replay are checked. An extra writer can preserve all public records while breaking actual coverage. Physical semantics, complete mediation, report/fault coverage and atomic execution remain conditions; the exposure setter is not physical recovery and no protected runtime is implemented. Interrupted recovery adds 22 theorems / 48 audits and 27,888 finite matches (17 empty dependencies). Remaining n writes plus publication require n+1 units and corresponding time; restart retains consumption. At nine units, recovery exhausts while activity keeps running and ordinary shutdown is blocked; losing the pending marker can expose a false certificate. Durable primitives, atomic microsteps/publication, overwrite semantics, no bypass and current reports remain supplied. The previous instruction result is migrated as mediated-evidence-transport; the delta is recoverable-mediated-change, without recounting the prior 27. Reserved stopping adds 21 theorems / 51 audits (18 empty) and 7,272 finite matches. It reuses recovery coherence and the existing three-step command, stopping within R−2 supervisor cycles from R remaining units without recovery success. Independent stop authority/channel, durable protection, bounded delay, attempt cost and continued scheduling remain supplied; excessive interruption retains a running failure. The old nine-unit failure remains for the old protocol; new admission refuses it rather than repairing it retroactively. Canonical ID: reserved-shutdown-during-recovery.

sections.title_zh: 六、原话、评审与证据入口

entries.title_zh: 非二元方法与生生方向：其来源
entries.title_en: The nondual method and the generative direction: their sources
entries.claim_zh: 来源把非二元方法记为纠正与方向，即从同一生成展开解释关系分化；把生生方向记为一次回答：生生是好的方向，保留多个“生”的研究范围。二者逐字保存。
entries.claim_en: The sources state the nondual method as a correction and direction, explaining differentiation within one unfolding, and the generative direction as an answer: Shengsheng is a good direction, with multiple ranges of life/formation retained. Both are kept verbatim.
entries.scope_zh: 研究指令与回答逐字保存，连同其理论来源：本链所循的方法与方向；它们不计作证明。
entries.scope_en: Research instructions and answers, kept verbatim, and their theoretical sources: the method and the direction the chain followed; they are not proofs.

entries.title_zh: 零公理与显式前提两条路线的来源
entries.title_en: Sources for zero-axiom and explicit-premise routes
entries.claim_zh: 保留“生成重要”的显式起点研究，同时继续更强的零公理理论；两条路线分别报告完成范围。
entries.claim_en: Retain inquiry from an explicit generation-matters premise while pursuing the stronger zero-axiom theory; report their achievements separately.
entries.scope_zh: 原话逐字保存，连同执行范围：它们开启这两条路线；不能把一条路线的结果当成另一条已完成。
entries.scope_en: Direct messages, kept verbatim, and their execution scope: they open the two routes; success of one route does not complete the other.

entries.title_zh: 条件性统一基础的完成审查
entries.title_en: Completion review of the conditional foundation
entries.claim_zh: 共同基础已在显式根据、相连推导、组合、生成/退化解释和区分性支持五项原定条件下被接受。
entries.claim_en: The conditional foundation has been accepted under its five original criteria: explicit grounds, connected derivation, composition, constructive/destructive regimes and discriminating support.
entries.scope_zh: 声明范围内完成；普遍经验真理、唯一必要性和零假设根据仍开放。
entries.scope_en: Complete at its declared scope; universal empirical truth, unique necessity and assumption-free grounding remain open.

entries.title_zh: 规范根据的正面论证与实质反审
entries.title_en: Affirmative grounding arguments and substantive counterreview
entries.claim_zh: 同一完整关系须接受正面解释、保留其事实的强对手和证据评估；思想案例与形式反例各有范围。
entries.claim_en: The same complete relationship faces an affirmative explanation, a substantive rival preserving its facts, and evidence assessment; thought cases and formal counterexamples retain their scopes.
entries.scope_zh: 研究评审与来源入口；不把评审次数或原文引用数当作证明。
entries.scope_en: Research review and source entry points; neither review counts nor citation counts constitute proof.

entries.title_zh: 良知的经典与发展证据
entries.title_en: Classical and developmental evidence for Liangzhi
entries.claim_zh: 经典文本、社会形成与发展研究为具体机制和解释提供比较；形成动机的证据不直接证明伦理有效性。
entries.claim_en: Classical texts and studies of social formation and development constrain particular mechanisms and interpretations; evidence for motivation formation does not directly establish ethical validity.
entries.scope_zh: 各来源按原阅读和研究范围使用；不是新经验实验。
entries.scope_en: Each source retains its recorded reading and evidential scope; no new empirical experiment.

entries.title_zh: 实际对应与证据范围
entries.title_en: Real-world correspondence and evidential scope
entries.claim_zh: 模型、合成检验、实际观察与哲学根据承担不同工作，保留来源谱系及反例。生命证据连接维护、功能恢复、有效组织及后续参与；区分可投入能力、推断参与、替代损失的生产和净增长。转变研究区分材料保留与变化后的要求；中断形成的谱系实验和生长中单个区室的对照进一步检验既有供给何时不足，支持三类机制的整合。
entries.claim_en: Models, synthetic checks, observation and philosophical warrant do different work, preserving provenance and counterexamples. Living evidence connects maintenance, functional recovery, effective organization and later participation, distinguishing recruitable capacity, inferred engagement, replacement production and net growth. Transition studies separate material retention from changed requirements; interrupted-formation lineages and a growing-compartment contrast further test inherited insufficiency, supporting the three-mode synthesis.
entries.scope_zh: 一般生命说明的证据整合已获审查，不等于全部现实均已验证。量恢复不证明全部功能；受损制备可保留残余活性。不同物种、版本和制备不合并成同一历史；分裂停止不等于死亡，荧光不等于精确有效副本数。计数增加不等于功能充分，当前供给不等于历次出生数。批次无物理时长，平均速率不自动成为逐历史上界；普遍更新期限与伦理权威均未证明。
entries.scope_en: The evidence synthesis for the general living account is reviewed, without verifying the entire real domain. Amount restoration does not prove full function; impaired preparations can retain residual activity. Different organisms, versions and preparations are not one history; division arrest is not death, and fluorescence is not an exact functional-copy count. Count increase is not functional sufficiency, and current provision is not cumulative births. Batches supply no physical duration; mean rates do not automatically bound every history. Universal renewal deadlines and ethical authority remain unproved.
